after..github/workflows/compat.yml:
name: Compatibility

# Advisory until the later owner step makes compat a required check.
# The reviewed source-built experiment retains an explicit readiness switch.
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rollback_target:
        description: Optional signed record tag or prod-0000
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""

permissions: {}

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  COMPAT_ROLLBACK_TARGET: ${{ inputs.rollback_target || '' }}
  PINNED_GH_VERSION: "2.98.0"
  PINNED_GH_URL: https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v2.98.0/gh_2.98.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
  PINNED_GH_SHA256: 3b8ac6b30336802fc1a858d7c084e11cdf24ac1a761ca90b68022d7d729208de
  PINNED_BUILDX_URL: https://github.com/docker/buildx/releases/download/v0.36.1/buildx-v0.36.1.linux-amd64
  PINNED_BUILDX_SHA256: 48af8a397ebd60178778bf63611dbcebe5f5e7a9be90eb9147b24b9587455778

jobs:
  release-preview:
    name: release-preview
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      attestations: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install pinned read-only GitHub CLI
        timeout-minutes: 1
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tools="$RUNNER_TEMP/compat-tools"
          mkdir -m 0700 "$tools"
          curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 20 \
            "$PINNED_GH_URL" -o "$tools/gh.tar.gz"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_GH_SHA256" "$tools/gh.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "$tools/gh.tar.gz" -C "$tools"
          install -m 0755 "$tools/gh_${PINNED_GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64/bin/gh" "$tools/gh"
          printf 'COMPAT_GH_BIN=%s\n' "$tools/gh" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      # One 600s deadline covers full-chain verification and source classification,
      # including constructor checks and capture cleanup. The step adds 60s;
      # the job retains 240s outside that step for checkout, install and upload.
      - name: Freeze latest and selected signed release identities
        id: preview
        timeout-minutes: 11
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/compat/cli.py preview

      - name: Upload this run's verified resolution
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: compat-resolution-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/compat-preview-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/public/resolution.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  compat-run:
    name: compat-run
    needs: release-preview
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 80
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      attestations: read
    steps:
      - name: Start the aggregate setup clock
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B - <<'PY'
          import os, time
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
              stream.write(f'COMPAT_SETUP_STARTED={time.monotonic()}\n')
          PY

      - name: Check out the exact candidate
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Download this run's exact resolution
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          name: compat-resolution-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/compat-input

      - name: Install pinned anonymous build and read-only release tools
        timeout-minutes: 1
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tools="$RUNNER_TEMP/compat-tools"
          mkdir -m 0700 "$tools"
          curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 20 \
            "$PINNED_GH_URL" -o "$tools/gh.tar.gz"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_GH_SHA256" "$tools/gh.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "$tools/gh.tar.gz" -C "$tools"
          install -m 0755 "$tools/gh_${PINNED_GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64/bin/gh" "$tools/gh"
          curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 20 \
            "$PINNED_BUILDX_URL" -o "$tools/docker-buildx"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_BUILDX_SHA256" "$tools/docker-buildx" | sha256sum --check --strict
          chmod 0755 "$tools/docker-buildx"
          {
            printf 'COMPAT_GH_BIN=%s\n' "$tools/gh"
            printf 'COMPAT_BUILDX_BIN=%s\n' "$tools/docker-buildx"
            printf 'COMPAT_DOCKER_BIN=%s\n' "$(readlink -f "$(command -v docker)")"
          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Enforce the shared setup allocation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B - <<'PY'
          import math, os, time
          elapsed = time.monotonic() - float(os.environ['COMPAT_SETUP_STARTED'])
          if not math.isfinite(elapsed) or not 0 <= elapsed <= 180:
              raise SystemExit('compat-setup-budget-exceeded')
          PY

      # 180s setup + 4500s core + <=5s client check + 60s upload leaves55s.
      # The76-minute step ceiling avoids cutting off the core during cleanup;
      # it does not extend the core's internally enforced4500-second deadline.
      # Cold builds can fail this budget; no independent per-image window.
      - name: Run the bounded experiment against the frozen signed selection
        id: experiment
        timeout-minutes: 76
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/compat/cli.py run

      - name: Upload only the complete measured result
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: compat-measured-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/compat-run-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/public/compat-result.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  compat:
    name: compat
    needs:
      - release-preview
      - compat-run
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    outputs:
      evidence_ready: ${{ steps.ready.outputs.evidence_ready }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact candidate
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Download this run's exact resolution
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          name: compat-resolution-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/compat-input

      - name: Download this run's exact measured result
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          name: compat-measured-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/compat-input

      - name: Validate complete identity and evaluate the measured verdict
        id: check
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          COMPAT_PREVIEW_OUTCOME: ${{ needs.release-preview.result }}
          COMPAT_RUN_OUTCOME: ${{ needs.compat-run.result }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/compat/cli.py check

      - name: Upload the canonical evidence including measured negative verdicts
        id: canonical
        if: ${{ always() && steps.check.outputs.complete == 'true' }}
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: compat-result-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/compat-check-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/public/compat-result.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/compat-check-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/public/compat-context.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Mark only a complete published evidence pair
        id: ready
        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && steps.check.outputs.complete == 'true' && steps.canonical.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf '%s\n' 'evidence_ready=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Require proof and publication success
        if: ${{ always() }}
        env:
          PREVIEW_RESULT: ${{ needs.release-preview.result }}
          RUN_RESULT: ${{ needs.compat-run.result }}
          CHECK_RESULT: ${{ steps.check.outcome }}
          UPLOAD_RESULT: ${{ steps.canonical.outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B - <<'PY'
          import os
          if any(os.environ[name] != 'success' for name in ('PREVIEW_RESULT', 'RUN_RESULT', 'CHECK_RESULT', 'UPLOAD_RESULT')):
              raise SystemExit(1)
          PY

  attest:
    name: compat-attest
    needs:
      - release-preview
      - compat-run
      - compat
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && needs.compat.outputs.evidence_ready == 'true' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 18
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
      attestations: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact candidate
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Download this run's exact resolution
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          name: compat-resolution-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/compat-input

      - name: Download this run's exact canonical evidence
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          name: compat-result-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/compat-input

      - name: Revalidate the canonical bytes and frozen selection
        id: check
        env:
          COMPAT_PREVIEW_OUTCOME: ${{ needs.release-preview.result }}
          COMPAT_RUN_OUTCOME: ${{ needs.compat-run.result }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/compat/attest_evidence.py

      # 5 existing setup/sign minutes + 1 install + 11 publisher leave 1 minute.
      # The publisher retains its original 600s / 10-call / 2MiB internal limits.
      - name: Install pinned GitHub CLI for negative evidence
        id: install-gh
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.check.outcome == 'success' && steps.check.outputs.complete == 'true' }}
        timeout-minutes: 1
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tools="$RUNNER_TEMP/compat-tools"
          mkdir -m 0700 "$tools"
          curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 20 \
            "$PINNED_GH_URL" -o "$tools/gh.tar.gz"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_GH_SHA256" "$tools/gh.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "$tools/gh.tar.gz" -C "$tools"
          install -m 0755 "$tools/gh_${PINNED_GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64/bin/gh" "$tools/gh"
          printf 'COMPAT_GH_BIN=%s\n' "$tools/gh" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Persist complete negative intent before either signature
        id: negative-index
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.check.outcome == 'success' && steps.check.outputs.complete == 'true' && steps.install-gh.outcome == 'success' }}
        timeout-minutes: 11
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          COMPAT_PREVIEW_OUTCOME: ${{ needs.release-preview.result }}
          COMPAT_RUN_OUTCOME: ${{ needs.compat-run.result }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/compat/negative_index.py

      - name: Attest the complete result without changing its verdict
        id: sign
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.check.outcome == 'success' && steps.check.outputs.complete == 'true' && steps.install-gh.outcome == 'success' && steps.negative-index.outcome == 'success' }}
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/compat-validate-evidence-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/public/compat-result.json
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Attest the context bound to the exact result digest
        id: sign-context
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.check.outcome == 'success' && steps.check.outputs.complete == 'true' && steps.install-gh.outcome == 'success' && steps.negative-index.outcome == 'success' && steps.sign.outcome == 'success' }}
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/compat-validate-evidence-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/public/compat-context.json
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Require the attestation to complete
        if: ${{ always() }}
        env:
          CHECK_RESULT: ${{ steps.check.outcome }}
          INSTALL_RESULT: ${{ steps.install-gh.outcome }}
          INDEX_RESULT: ${{ steps.negative-index.outcome }}
          SIGN_RESULT: ${{ steps.sign.outcome }}
          CONTEXT_SIGN_RESULT: ${{ steps.sign-context.outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B - <<'PY'
          import os
          import sys
          names = ('CHECK_RESULT', 'INSTALL_RESULT', 'INDEX_RESULT', 'SIGN_RESULT', 'CONTEXT_SIGN_RESULT')
          sys.exit(0 if all(os.environ.get(name) == 'success' for name in names) else 1)
          PY
after..github/workflows/ship.yml:
name: Release

run-name: Release ${{ inputs.mode }} ${{ inputs.target_release }}

# Promote-by-digest and the separate synthetic staging lane. Production's
# deploy token is released only after the owner approves in the GitHub UI.
# Staging provider tokens are confined to its deploy/rollback steps; the CRM
# test job receives only the minimal synthetic fixture inputs.
# docs/release.md is the runbook; docs/emergency-rollback.md is the
# owner-run console fallback.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: dry-run, promote, rollback, stage, or urgent owner-only promote-without-staging
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: dry-run
        options:
          - dry-run
          - promote
          - rollback
          - stage
          - promote-without-staging
      drill:
        description: Staging-only failure rehearsal
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: none
        options:
          - none
          - e2e-fail
          - health-fail
          - bad-image
      target_release:
        description: Rollback only, a record tag such as prod-20261004T101500Z-0123abcd or prod-0000
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""

permissions: {}

# Serializes every Release run. The old launcher also treats any workflow
# with a top-level concurrency block it does not recognise as lock-relevant.
concurrency:
  group: ship-release
  cancel-in-progress: false

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  SHIP_REPOSITORY: medtechcorps-netizen/whatomate
  SHIP_WORKFLOW_PATH: .github/workflows/ship.yml
  PINNED_GH_VERSION: "2.98.0"
  PINNED_GH_URL: https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v2.98.0/gh_2.98.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
  PINNED_GH_SHA256: 3b8ac6b30336802fc1a858d7c084e11cdf24ac1a761ca90b68022d7d729208de
  PINNED_TRIVY_VERSION: "0.70.0"
  PINNED_TRIVY_URL: https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/download/v0.70.0/trivy_0.70.0_Linux-64bit.tar.gz
  PINNED_TRIVY_SHA256: 8b4376d5d6befe5c24d503f10ff136d9e0c49f9127a4279fd110b727929a5aa9
  PINNED_SYFT_VERSION: "1.51.0"
  PINNED_SYFT_URL: https://github.com/anchore/syft/releases/download/v1.51.0/syft_1.51.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
  PINNED_SYFT_SHA256: 2a2e837a2c8d59ec9af5472ee22d3b04ee463c4e44476ecf993fd1e5ab6ebc7f
  PINNED_BUILDX_VERSION: v0.36.1
  PINNED_BUILDX_URL: https://github.com/docker/buildx/releases/download/v0.36.1/buildx-v0.36.1.linux-amd64
  PINNED_BUILDX_SHA256: 48af8a397ebd60178778bf63611dbcebe5f5e7a9be90eb9147b24b9587455778
  PINNED_BUILDKIT_IMAGE: docker.io/moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1@sha256:040d34121c27906c4ff9ac152a30d52bf2c5d328d3bb748916bb3d2743c02528

jobs:
  plan:
    name: Release plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # Normal preflight is bounded at 2400s; retain 300s for setup and gates.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      actions: read
      attestations: read
      contents: read
    outputs:
      latest_release: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.latest_release }}
      latest_manifest_sha256: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.latest_manifest_sha256 }}
      latest_sha: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.latest_sha }}
      target_release: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.target_release }}
      target_manifest_sha256: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.target_manifest_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - name: Refuse re-runs
        env:
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME: ${{ runner.environment }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$RUN_ATTEMPT" == "1" ]]
          [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == "refs/heads/main" ]]
          [[ "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME" == "github-hosted" ]]

      - name: Check out the dispatched commit
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install pinned GitHub CLI
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tools_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-tools"
          install -d -m 0755 "$tools_dir"
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 \
            "$PINNED_GH_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_GH_SHA256" "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          install -m 0755 "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh_${PINNED_GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64/bin/gh" "$tools_dir/gh"
          read -r gh_name gh_word gh_version _ < <("$tools_dir/gh" --version)
          [[ "$gh_name $gh_word $gh_version" == "gh version $PINNED_GH_VERSION" ]]
          printf 'SHIP_GH_BIN=%s\n' "$tools_dir/gh" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Plan the release
        id: plan
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SHIP_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
          SHIP_DRILL: ${{ inputs.drill }}
          SHIP_TARGET_RELEASE: ${{ inputs.target_release }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py plan

  images:
    name: Release image (${{ matrix.component }})
    needs: plan
    if: ${{ contains(fromJSON('["dry-run","promote","stage","promote-without-staging"]'), inputs.mode) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        component:
          - web
          - meta-relay
          - gmail-relay
    steps:
      - name: Refuse re-runs
        env:
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME: ${{ runner.environment }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$RUN_ATTEMPT" == "1" ]]
          [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == "refs/heads/main" ]]
          [[ "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME" == "github-hosted" ]]

      - name: Check out the dispatched commit
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Require reviewed Dockerfile pins
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py image --stage pins --component "$COMPONENT"

      - name: Install pinned Trivy and Syft
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tools_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-tools"
          install -d -m 0755 "$tools_dir"
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 \
            "$PINNED_TRIVY_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy.tar.gz"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_TRIVY_SHA256" "$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy.tar.gz" -C "$tools_dir" trivy
          [[ "$("$tools_dir/trivy" --version | awk '/^Version:/ {print $2; exit}')" == "$PINNED_TRIVY_VERSION" ]]
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 \
            "$PINNED_SYFT_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/syft.tar.gz"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_SYFT_SHA256" "$RUNNER_TEMP/syft.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/syft.tar.gz" -C "$tools_dir" syft
          "$tools_dir/syft" version | grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*Version:[[:space:]]+$PINNED_SYFT_VERSION$"
          printf '%s\n' "$tools_dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Install pinned Docker Buildx and start pinned BuildKit
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          plugin_dir="$HOME/.docker/cli-plugins"
          mkdir -p "$plugin_dir"
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 \
            "$PINNED_BUILDX_URL" -o "$plugin_dir/docker-buildx"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_BUILDX_SHA256" "$plugin_dir/docker-buildx" | sha256sum --check --strict
          chmod 0755 "$plugin_dir/docker-buildx"
          [[ "$(docker buildx version | awk '{print $2}')" == "$PINNED_BUILDX_VERSION" ]]
          docker buildx create \
            --name rereply-ship \
            --driver docker-container \
            --driver-opt "image=$PINNED_BUILDKIT_IMAGE" \
            --use
          docker buildx inspect --bootstrap rereply-ship

      - name: Create a unique non-authority tag
        id: identity
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$COMPONENT" =~ ^(web|meta-relay|gmail-relay)$ ]]
          [[ "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          image="ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-$COMPONENT"
          tag="ship-${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}-r${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          [[ "$tag" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,127}$ ]]
          {
            printf 'tag=%s\n' "$tag"
            printf 'image=%s\n' "$image"
            printf 'image_ref=%s:%s\n' "$image" "$tag"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Build the exact AMD64 image without registry credentials
        uses: docker/build-push-action@10e90e3645eae34f1e60eeb005ba3a3d33f178e8 # v6
        env:
          DOCKER_BUILD_RECORD_UPLOAD: "false"
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./docker/release/${{ matrix.component }}.Dockerfile
          platforms: linux/amd64
          push: false
          load: true
          pull: true
          no-cache: true
          provenance: false
          sbom: false
          builder: rereply-ship
          # The build reads the verified local checkout; never hand the
          # workflow token to BuildKit as a Git authentication secret.
          github-token: ""
          tags: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image_ref }}
          # UBUNTU_SNAPSHOT is deliberately not passed: the Dockerfile ARG
          # default is the exact value production was built with.
          build-args: |
            TARGETOS=linux
            TARGETARCH=amd64
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/medtechcorps-netizen/whatomate
            org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ github.sha }}
            org.opencontainers.image.version=ship-${{ github.sha }}
            org.opencontainers.image.title=rereply-release-${{ matrix.component }}
            io.rereply.release.workflow=ship

      - name: Publish the unique non-authority tag
        id: publish
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image }}
          IMAGE_REF: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image_ref }}
          REGISTRY_USER: ${{ github.actor }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$IMAGE_REF" == "$IMAGE:"* ]]
          trap 'docker logout ghcr.io >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
          printf '%s' "$GH_TOKEN" | docker login ghcr.io --username "$REGISTRY_USER" --password-stdin
          docker push "$IMAGE_REF" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/docker-push.txt"
          mapfile -t pushed_digests < <(
            sed -nE 's/^.*digest:[[:space:]]*(sha256:[0-9a-f]{64})([[:space:]].*)?$/\1/p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/docker-push.txt"
          )
          [[ "${#pushed_digests[@]}" -eq 1 ]]
          digest="${pushed_digests[0]}"
          [[ "$digest" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
          docker buildx imagetools inspect "$IMAGE@$digest" --raw > "$RUNNER_TEMP/published-manifest.json"
          [[ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/published-manifest.json" && ! -L "$RUNNER_TEMP/published-manifest.json" ]]
          manifest_sha256="$(sha256sum "$RUNNER_TEMP/published-manifest.json" | awk '{print $1}')"
          [[ "sha256:$manifest_sha256" == "$digest" ]]
          printf 'digest=%s\n' "$digest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Verify the runtime contract
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          image_ref="$IMAGE@$DIGEST"
          install -d -m 0700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-scan"
          docker pull --platform linux/amd64 "$image_ref"
          docker image inspect "$image_ref" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-scan/inspect.json"
          /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py image --stage contract --component "$COMPONENT"
          case "$COMPONENT" in
            web)
              docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --entrypoint /bin/sh "$image_ref" \
                -ceu '
                  uid="$(id -u)"
                  test "$uid" -gt 0
                  test "$(id -un)" = rereply
                  model=/opt/piper/models/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx
                  config=/opt/piper/models/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx.json
                  test -s "$model" && test -r "$model" && test "$(stat -c %a "$model")" = 644
                  test -s "$config" && test -r "$config" && test "$(stat -c %a "$config")" = 644
                  test -s /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
                  test -r /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
                  test -x /usr/local/bin/piper
                  test -d /usr/share/espeak-ng-data
                  test -d /app/audio && test -w /app/audio
                  printf "%s\n" "release image smoke test" |
                    piper --model "$model" --output_file /app/audio/release-smoke.wav
                  test -s /app/audio/release-smoke.wav
                  opusenc --quiet /app/audio/release-smoke.wav /app/audio/release-smoke.ogg
                  test -s /app/audio/release-smoke.ogg
                  ffmpeg -nostdin -v error -i /app/audio/release-smoke.ogg -f null -
                  test "$(stat -c %u /app/audio/release-smoke.wav)" = "$uid"
                  test "$(stat -c %u /app/audio/release-smoke.ogg)" = "$uid"
                '
              docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 "$image_ref" version
              ;;
            meta-relay|gmail-relay)
              binary="/app/$COMPONENT"
              container_id="$(docker create --platform linux/amd64 "$image_ref")"
              trap 'docker rm -f "$container_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
              docker export "$container_id" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-rootfs.tar"
              tar -xOf "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-rootfs.tar" etc/passwd | grep -Fx 'relay:x:65532:65532:ReReply relay:/app:/sbin/nologin'
              tar -xOf "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-rootfs.tar" etc/group | grep -Fx 'relay:x:65532:'
              tar -xOf "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-rootfs.tar" etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt > "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-ca-certificates.crt"
              [[ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-ca-certificates.crt" ]]
              tar -tvf "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-rootfs.tar" | grep -E -- "^-rwx[^[:space:]]*[[:space:]].*[[:space:]]${binary#/}$"
              docker rm "$container_id" > /dev/null
              trap - EXIT
              ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::Unsupported runtime smoke contract."
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Check reviewed vulnerability exceptions
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py trivy-policy

      - name: Download a fresh Trivy database
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export TRIVY_CACHE_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy-cache"
          trivy image \
            --cache-dir "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR" \
            --download-db-only \
            --skip-version-check
          /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py image --stage trivy-db --component "$COMPONENT"

      - name: Fail on embedded secrets
        env:
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          trivy image \
            --cache-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy-cache" \
            --skip-db-update \
            --skip-version-check \
            --scanners secret \
            --image-config-scanners secret \
            --exit-code 1 \
            --format json \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-scan/secret-report.json" \
            --timeout 30m \
            "$IMAGE@$DIGEST"

      - name: Fail on HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerabilities
        env:
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          trivy image \
            --cache-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy-cache" \
            --skip-db-update \
            --skip-version-check \
            --scanners vuln \
            --pkg-types os,library \
            --severity HIGH,CRITICAL \
            --ignorefile release/deployment/ship.trivyignore \
            --exit-code 1 \
            --format json \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-scan/vulnerability-report.json" \
            --timeout 30m \
            "$IMAGE@$DIGEST"

      - name: Generate the SPDX SBOM
        env:
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image }}
          SYFT_CHECK_FOR_APP_UPDATE: "false"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          syft scan "docker:$IMAGE@$DIGEST" --output "spdx-json=$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-scan/sbom.spdx.json"

      - name: Record the image
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.tag }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py image --stage record --component "$COMPONENT"

      - name: Upload the image record
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: ship-image-${{ matrix.component }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ship-image/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  attest:
    name: Release attestations
    needs:
      - plan
      - images
    if: ${{ contains(fromJSON('["dry-run","promote","stage","promote-without-staging"]'), inputs.mode) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      attestations: write
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    outputs:
      candidate_b64: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.candidate_b64 }}
      candidate_sha256: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.candidate_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - name: Refuse re-runs
        env:
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME: ${{ runner.environment }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$RUN_ATTEMPT" == "1" ]]
          [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == "refs/heads/main" ]]
          [[ "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME" == "github-hosted" ]]

      - name: Check out the dispatched commit
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install pinned GitHub CLI
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tools_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-tools"
          install -d -m 0755 "$tools_dir"
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 \
            "$PINNED_GH_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_GH_SHA256" "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          install -m 0755 "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh_${PINNED_GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64/bin/gh" "$tools_dir/gh"
          read -r gh_name gh_word gh_version _ < <("$tools_dir/gh" --version)
          [[ "$gh_name $gh_word $gh_version" == "gh version $PINNED_GH_VERSION" ]]
          printf 'SHIP_GH_BIN=%s\n' "$tools_dir/gh" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Download the three image records
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          pattern: ship-image-*-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ship-images
          merge-multiple: false

      - name: Read the three image records
        id: images
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py candidate --stage read

      - name: Attest web provenance
        id: prov-web
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-web
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.web }}
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Attest web SBOM
        id: sbom-web
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-web
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.web }}
          sbom-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ship-images/ship-image-web-${{ github.run_id }}/sbom.spdx.json
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Attest meta-relay provenance
        id: prov-meta-relay
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-meta-relay
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.meta_relay }}
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Attest meta-relay SBOM
        id: sbom-meta-relay
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-meta-relay
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.meta_relay }}
          sbom-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ship-images/ship-image-meta-relay-${{ github.run_id }}/sbom.spdx.json
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Attest gmail-relay provenance
        id: prov-gmail-relay
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-gmail-relay
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.gmail_relay }}
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Attest gmail-relay SBOM
        id: sbom-gmail-relay
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-gmail-relay
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.gmail_relay }}
          sbom-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ship-images/ship-image-gmail-relay-${{ github.run_id }}/sbom.spdx.json
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Verify every attestation
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SHIP_PROV_BUNDLE_WEB: ${{ steps.prov-web.outputs.bundle-path }}
          SHIP_SBOM_BUNDLE_WEB: ${{ steps.sbom-web.outputs.bundle-path }}
          SHIP_PROV_BUNDLE_META_RELAY: ${{ steps.prov-meta-relay.outputs.bundle-path }}
          SHIP_SBOM_BUNDLE_META_RELAY: ${{ steps.sbom-meta-relay.outputs.bundle-path }}
          SHIP_PROV_BUNDLE_GMAIL_RELAY: ${{ steps.prov-gmail-relay.outputs.bundle-path }}
          SHIP_SBOM_BUNDLE_GMAIL_RELAY: ${{ steps.sbom-gmail-relay.outputs.bundle-path }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py candidate --stage verify

      - name: Require anonymous pullability
        env:
          DOCKER_CONFIG: ${{ runner.temp }}/anonymous-docker-config
          WEB_DIGEST: ${{ steps.images.outputs.web }}
          META_RELAY_DIGEST: ${{ steps.images.outputs.meta_relay }}
          GMAIL_RELAY_DIGEST: ${{ steps.images.outputs.gmail_relay }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          unset GH_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN CR_PAT REGISTRY_TOKEN DOCKER_AUTH_CONFIG
          [[ ! -e "$DOCKER_CONFIG" ]]
          install -d -m 0700 "$DOCKER_CONFIG"
          [[ -z "$(find "$DOCKER_CONFIG" -mindepth 1 -print -quit)" ]]
          pulled=0
          for pair in "web=$WEB_DIGEST" "meta-relay=$META_RELAY_DIGEST" "gmail-relay=$GMAIL_RELAY_DIGEST"; do
            component="${pair%%=*}"
            digest="${pair#*=}"
            [[ "$digest" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
            subject="ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-$component@$digest"
            docker pull --platform linux/amd64 "$subject" > /dev/null
            [[ "$(docker image inspect --format '{{json .RepoDigests}}' "$subject")" == *"\"$subject\""* ]]
            pulled=$((pulled + 1))
          done
          [[ "$pulled" -eq 3 ]]
          [[ ! -e "$DOCKER_CONFIG/config.json" ]]

      - name: Assemble the candidate
        id: candidate
        env:
          SHIP_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py candidate --stage assemble

  deploy-staging:
    name: Release staging
    needs:
      - plan
      - attest
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && contains(fromJSON('["stage","promote"]'), inputs.mode) && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.attest.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 120
    environment: staging
    concurrency:
      group: ship-staging
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      actions: read
      attestations: read
      contents: read
    outputs:
      receipt_b64: ${{ steps.stage.outputs.receipt_b64 }}
      receipt_sha256: ${{ steps.stage.outputs.receipt_sha256 }}
    # No uses steps can run beside the provider token.
    steps:
      - name: Refuse re-runs
        env:
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME: ${{ runner.environment }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$RUN_ATTEMPT" == "1" ]]
          [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == "refs/heads/main" ]]
          [[ "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME" == "github-hosted" ]]
          [[ "${RUNNER_DEBUG:-}" != "1" ]]

      - name: Fetch the dispatched commit without credentials
        env:
          GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git clone --quiet --no-checkout --single-branch --branch main --no-tags \
            "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src"
          git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src" checkout --quiet --detach "$GITHUB_SHA"
          [[ "$(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src" rev-parse HEAD)" == "$GITHUB_SHA" ]]
          [[ -z "$(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/src" status --porcelain)" ]]

      - name: Install pinned GitHub CLI
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tools_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-tools"
          install -d -m 0755 "$tools_dir"
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 \
            "$PINNED_GH_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_GH_SHA256" "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          install -m 0755 "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh_${PINNED_GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64/bin/gh" "$tools_dir/gh"
          read -r gh_name gh_word gh_version _ < <("$tools_dir/gh" --version)
          [[ "$gh_name $gh_word $gh_version" == "gh version $PINNED_GH_VERSION" ]]
          printf 'SHIP_GH_BIN=%s\n' "$tools_dir/gh" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Verify and deploy staging
        id: stage
        working-directory: src
        env:
          STAGING_DO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.STAGING_DO_TOKEN }}
          STAGING_TARGET_JSON: ${{ secrets.STAGING_TARGET_JSON }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SHIP_MODE: stage
          SHIP_DRILL: ${{ inputs.drill }}
          SHIP_TARGET_RELEASE: ${{ inputs.target_release }}
          PLAN_LATEST_RELEASE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.latest_release }}
          PLAN_LATEST_MANIFEST_SHA256: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.latest_manifest_sha256 }}
          CANDIDATE_B64: ${{ needs.attest.outputs.candidate_b64 }}
          CANDIDATE_SHA256: ${{ needs.attest.outputs.candidate_sha256 }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/stage.py deploy

  e2e-staging:
    name: Release staging CRM checks
    needs:
      - attest
      - deploy-staging
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && contains(fromJSON('["stage","promote"]'), inputs.mode) && needs.attest.result == 'success' && needs.deploy-staging.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment: staging-e2e
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.57.0-noble@sha256:8fb7af3bb488c51364d6554876a8eddf377736608327dbdf4177b4901faf7bc9
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      report_b64: ${{ steps.report.outputs.report_b64 }}
      report_sha256: ${{ steps.report.outputs.report_sha256 }}
      passed: ${{ steps.report.outputs.passed }}
    steps:
      - name: Mask staging fixture before all other steps
        env:
          STAGING_ORIGIN: ${{ secrets.STAGING_ORIGIN }}
          STAGING_CANARY_FIXTURE_JSON: ${{ secrets.STAGING_CANARY_FIXTURE_JSON }}
          STAGING_STUB_CONTROL_KEY: ${{ secrets.STAGING_STUB_CONTROL_KEY }}
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME: ${{ runner.environment }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, re, sys
          try:
              names = ('STAGING_ORIGIN', 'STAGING_CANARY_FIXTURE_JSON', 'STAGING_STUB_CONTROL_KEY')
              values = [os.environ[name] for name in names]
              if not all(values): raise ValueError()
              def mask(value):
                  if isinstance(value, str) and value:
                      print('::add-mask::' + value.replace('%', '%25').replace('\r', '%0D').replace('\n', '%0A'))
                  elif isinstance(value, dict):
                      for child in value.values(): mask(child)
                  elif isinstance(value, list):
                      for child in value: mask(child)
              for value in values: mask(value)
              def unique_object(pairs):
                  result = {}
                  for key, value in pairs:
                      if key in result: raise ValueError()
                      result[key] = value
                  return result
              def invalid_constant(value): raise ValueError()
              fixture = json.loads(values[1], object_pairs_hook=unique_object, parse_constant=invalid_constant)
              if type(fixture) is not dict or set(fixture) != {'schema_version', 'origin_sha256', 'canary'}: raise ValueError()
              if type(fixture['schema_version']) is not int or fixture['schema_version'] != 1: raise ValueError()
              if type(fixture['canary']) is not dict or fixture['canary'].get('origin') != values[0]: raise ValueError()
              digest = fixture['origin_sha256']
              if type(digest) is not str or re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', digest) is None: raise ValueError()
              if digest != hashlib.sha256(values[0].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(): raise ValueError()
              # The validated top-level checksum is public receipt/report data.
              # Mask every canary string, including any nested hash-shaped value.
              mask(fixture['canary'])
          except Exception:
              print('stage-fixture: refused', file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)
          PY
          [[ "$RUN_ATTEMPT" == "1" ]]
          [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == "refs/heads/main" ]]
          [[ "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME" == "github-hosted" ]]
          [[ "${RUNNER_DEBUG:-}" != "1" ]]

      - name: Check out the dispatched commit
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install frontend dependencies without lifecycle scripts
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts

      - name: Import fixture and run staging CRM checks
        id: canary
        env:
          STAGING_ORIGIN: ${{ secrets.STAGING_ORIGIN }}
          STAGING_CANARY_FIXTURE_JSON: ${{ secrets.STAGING_CANARY_FIXTURE_JSON }}
          STAGING_STUB_CONTROL_KEY: ${{ secrets.STAGING_STUB_CONTROL_KEY }}
          STAGE_RECEIPT_B64: ${{ needs.deploy-staging.outputs.receipt_b64 }}

after.docs/compat.md:
# Compatibility experiment and proof

`release/compat/proof.py` is a pure standard-library evidence evaluator. It has
no Docker, GitHub, filesystem, network or database operations. Its synthetic
tests exercise proof rules; they do **not** establish compatibility of a release.
The ordered experiment, source-built image admission and hosted entry points
are implemented and enabled in this source for hosted qualification. The
local positive experiment and swallowed-UPDATE fixture-branch advisory have
separate source-bound evidence described below. Hosted CI qualifies each
candidate. The three accepted consecutive main compatibility runs remain an
accepted prerequisite; this producer still requires its own exact-main
qualification. Component tests do not establish release compatibility.

## Result and failure contract

`evaluate_proof(observations)` returns exactly these public fields:

```text
sha, previous_release, previous_web_digest, classification, forward,
old_migrate_ok {rw, ro, negative_control},
old_server_ok {boot, read, write, reverse, workers},
reversible, catalog_sha256, run_id, run_attempt
```

`classification` contains only `{kind, dormant}`. Current classifier outputs
are `none/false`, `data/true` and source-bound pending `expand/true`; active
`expand/false` and `contract/false` are representable for their planned proof rules. This module
does not make or authorize a classification. The runner must bind the actual
verified classifier output, including rejection reasons, before evaluating a
proof. It must not substitute a more permissive kind. Source paths/reasons and
summaries are not copied into the public result.

Only **completed semantic failures** yield false flags. Infrastructure failures
(pull, network, boot timeout, capture or unclassified container/process failure)
refuse with fixed error codes and no result. Missing, not-run, incomplete,
malformed or ambiguous evidence raises `EvidenceError`.
A boot without its first log is infrastructure failure. A control whose
failure cannot be proved also raises; it is never a favorable partial result.
Every phase is validated even when an earlier semantic check fails.

One narrow postmigration terminal case can causally block dependent phases.
After the actual migration and independent read-only control observations,
`start_web` must return the bound previous-server handle. Complete append-only
logs must contain the source's start and RLS markers before an anchored Go
`panic:` in the same stream, with exit 2 and stable exited, non-OOM state.
Structured fatal records, runtime `fatal error:` lines (including mixed panic
windows), pre-RLS failures and missing or ambiguous evidence still refuse.
The private proof then binds blocked old read/write/workers and reverse
boot/read nodes to that observed cause; it does not invent completed sweeps.
Dependent public flags become false only after actual server removal, complete
journal sealing, final catalog capture and verified owned-resource cleanup.

`reversible` is derived solely from all three `old_migrate_ok` values. It is
not derived from forward or old-server results. Those other results remain
separate mandatory acceptance considerations for the later release policy.

`result_bytes` validates the exact shape and produces canonical sorted JSON
plus a newline. Public strings are limited to lowercase source/digest hex,
the release tag grammar, and bounded classification values. The only numeric
identity is the explicitly required GitHub run ID; run attempt is also
included. No table names, SQL, UUIDs, hostnames, local paths or raw log messages
are exported. Errors never include input values. `artifact_name` returns
`compat-result-<sha>-<run_attempt>` and accepts rerun attempts greater than one.
`validate_rollback_target` accepts the existing release tag regex or
`prod-0000`, with full-string matching.

## Structured observations

The exact required input keys are defined by `evaluate_proof` and demonstrated
by `observations()` in `test_proof.py`. Unknown keys refuse. The reusable shapes
are:

- Execution: `{status, exit_code, failure}`. Status must be `completed` with
  exit code 0-255 and failure `null`, or `infrastructure-error` with a fixed
  failure category. `not-run` or missing execution cannot establish a flag.
- Check: `{execution, passed}`. Only a successful completed execution and the
  explicit boolean `true` pass. Sweep observations add the exact six booleans
  `contacts`, `inbound`, `outbound`, `template`, `flow`, `settings` instead of a
  single passed flag.
- Table capture: `{complete: true, digests: {table_identity_sha256: data_sha256}}`.
  The runner must hash a deterministic, collision-resistant identity and data
  encoding, enumerate **every** table in the measured set and include empty
  tables. Missing/deleted entries are not an unchanged table. This core does
  not invent a row digest algorithm or query tenant data.
- Log window: `{raw: bytes, complete: true}` for a single designated
  application and phase. Markers are `{complete: true, application, hashes}`;
  their hashes bind canonical probe events captured by the owned collector.
- Migration: `{execution, log, markers, catalog_sha256, tables}`.

The top-level observations include the previous server boot/startup proof,
the sorted unique nonempty `expected_preexisting_tables` identity hashes from
the verified base catalog, before-forward table capture, target catalog, two forward passes, candidate
readiness/write sweep, stopped-candidate and zero-client quiescence with D0,
both N-1 migrations and the read-only control, all old-server sweeps/workers,
and the final catalog observation. They must come from one correctly ordered
experiment on the bound source and previous image. The evaluator cannot prove
collection completeness, provenance, ordering or signatures from booleans
and hashes alone; the owned runner measures and binds those facts. It must
never fabricate defaults when a phase did not run.
The before-capture keys must exactly equal that expected inventory; a vacuous
or omitted-table baseline refuses. D0 must retain the expected identities and
have exactly the post-forward table inventory. The independently established
expected inventory must not be derived from a possibly incomplete capture.

Both forward passes must succeed and equal the declared target catalog. Every
pre-existing table digest must remain unchanged for `none`, `expand`, or any
`dormant` classification. Additional tables may exist for an expansion.
`none` and dormant classes allow no mod statements or probe markers.
For those no-mod classes, each pass must also have exactly the before-table
inventory: an unknown extra table cannot hide behind a known-object catalog
SHA. Active expansions retain the allowed additional-table behavior. Other
classes require every observed mod/marker hash to appear in the explicit
classification-authorized hash sets. This is an exact authorization interface,
**not** an SQL parser or a derivation of which objects a migration may touch.
The later runner must derive those sets from the reviewed classification and
structured probe records; it cannot authorize whatever it just observed.

N-1 read-write and read-only results both require exit zero, no parsed errors,
no mod statements, no markers, the same D0 table inventory/digests and the
same catalog. A swallowed UPDATE with exit zero and unchanged data still fails
through its mod log or marker. A caught `25006` still fails the old read-only
migration even if its process exits zero.

The independent control must execute the exact fixed statement
`CREATE TABLE compat_probe.read_only_control (sentinel integer)` in the
read-only session. It must exit nonzero, report SQLSTATE `25006`, and its log
must contain exactly one `25006` primary error with that same diagnostic
STATEMENT. An optional matching mod-log attempt is allowed; a different query,
successful control, extra error, unrelated write or absent parser evidence
refuses the experiment. The probe schema stays outside `public`.

Previous/old server boot requires readiness and an observed startup contract.
If that contract line is unavailable, the structured fallback must prove
FORCE RLS was removed and the negative-control server refused to start.
The old-server read/write sweeps and candidate reverse sweep include all six
cases. Workers need at least 60 observed seconds with no panic, unknown-type
line or unexpected stub journal entry. A short successful window is incomplete;
an observed early crash is a semantic failure. The counts must cover the
relevant old-server observation period, not discard errors outside a selected
tail. The previous server must stop before candidate restart/reverse sweep.

## Narrow PostgreSQL log parser

`parse_pg_log` accepts only a **complete captured proof window**, already
bounded by the runner and assigned to one of:

```text
compat-prev-server  compat-cand-server  compat-fwd
compat-n1-rw        compat-n1-ro        compat-control
```

The required format is PostgreSQL text stderr with `log_timezone=UTC`, `lc_messages=C`,
`log_error_verbosity=verbose`, and `log_line_prefix='%m [%p] %a %e '`.
The runner must also set `log_statement=mod`,
`log_min_error_statement=error`, and disable autovacuum for the experiment.
This parser does not validate arbitrary PostgreSQL stderr. Startup/background
lines with a blank application name are outside the client proof window; the
runner must not silently discard an unattributed line inside that window.
Alongside the synthetic cases, a narrow local check against the pinned
PostgreSQL 17 image parsed three actual log forms: a multiline UPDATE, an
extended-protocol unnamed UPDATE, and the read-only CREATE control failing
with SQLSTATE `25006`. That check validates only those formats. Complete
proof-window collection, the full runner and release compatibility remain
unverified.

Primary VERBOSE records include the repeated SQLSTATE after the severity.
Following STATEMENT/LOCATION/DETAIL/HINT fields must belong to the same
PID/application/SQLSTATE. ERROR + STATEMENT + LOCATION is one error, not an
extra executed mod statement. A `LOG: ... statement:` or
`LOG: ... execute <unnamed>:` / simple named prepared-statement envelope counts
once and is hashed in full. A tab-prefixed physical continuation belongs to
the preceding field, so a multiline UPDATE counts once. A second prefix
hidden under a tab, orphan/unprefixed line, duplicate detail, mismatched
application, malformed SQLSTATE or truncated final line refuses.

Function CONTEXT traces, SELECT/DO/CALL as mod-statement envelopes, unexpected
LOG forms and other unsupported statement envelopes refuse rather than infer
nested effects. This is a conservative parser limitation, not a claim that
PostgreSQL logs every possible function side effect. Complete table digests
and DDL probe markers remain independent evidence. SQL is retained only long
enough to hash the statement; it never reaches the public result or errors.

The format references are the PostgreSQL 17 [logging settings](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/runtime-config-logging.html)
and [server error output implementation](https://github.com/postgres/postgres/blob/REL_17_STABLE/src/backend/utils/error/elog.c).
The latter prefixes LOCATION and STATEMENT separately and uses tab-prefixed
continuations. The former also documents mod logging for forms such as
COPY FROM, PREPARE/EXECUTE and EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Unsupported forms here remain
explicit refusals, not silently ignored statements. The exact locale/timezone
settings are required; these references do not replace a real PG17 integration
test of the future collector and parser together.

Limits are 8 MiB, 100,000 lines, 64 KiB per physical line and 10,000 statements
or errors per log; table/marker inventories are also bounded. The evaluator
accepts five such migration/control windows. An explicitly complete empty
window is valid under mod-only logging, but does not replace successful
execution evidence or the mandatory independently observed control failure.

## Bounded runtime foundation

`runtime.py` supplies the bounded CLI foundation for the experiment. It drains
stdout and stderr concurrently with separate byte limits, imposes a deadline,
and reaps its child process. A completed nonzero exit is captured as evidence;
it is not automatically a compatibility verdict. Process or capture failures
raise fixed infrastructure errors without exposing arguments or stream data.
Optional standard input is limited to 1 MiB and written concurrently under the
same deadline; a blocked or incomplete write refuses the capture. Without an
input value, standard input remains disconnected.
On POSIX, capture failure kills the private process group. On Windows, only
the direct child is killed; container cleanup remains the runner's separate
responsibility.

The Docker interface supports only digest-pinned PostgreSQL, Redis and verified
previous-web pulls/inspection for Linux AMD64. It uses a fresh empty config and
the default local context. The GitHub interface reuses the existing release
record, chain, exact certificate and image attestation validators. It bounds
read-only output and creates manifest files only in fresh scratch directories;
it cannot publish releases or overwrite/delete earlier evidence. Its caller
supplies reviewed executable paths, an explicit minimal environment and the
existing read-only job token in memory. It does not retrieve credentials.

The focused transport tests include real local Python child processes, while
Docker and GitHub are mocked. They establish the transport behavior, not a
live registry pull, a current signed release, or release compatibility. No
container lifecycle, workflow or publication is added by this foundation.

partial proof. Focused tests use fake HTTP
responses and verify payloads against current handlers. They do not establish

provisioning and container isolation remain runner responsibilities.

## Synthetic PostgreSQL collector

`postgres.py` collects table digests, DDL probe markers and complete log windows
inside an explicitly bound, task-owned PostgreSQL 17 container. It has no DSN
input. Container identity, label, image and network isolation are checked;
host mounts and published ports are refused. SQL reaches fixed database
`compat` through bounded standard input to `psql` inside that container.
The observer uses the fixed `/var/run/postgresql` Unix socket with password
prompting disabled. Only this disposable cluster uses local trust; application
TCP connections retain SCRAM authentication. No password is passed to the
collector and a failed socket connection has no TCP or password fallback.

The synthetic administrator observes all rows, including rows hidden by FORCE
RLS, while the migration owner remains a non-superuser and the separate runtime
role retains its restricted privileges. Observation never disables RLS.
One read-only repeatable-read snapshot inventories every public stored table,
partition and materialized view, including empty relations; foreign tables
refuse. Deterministic row encoding preserves nulls, duplicate rows and arbitrary
text. Forward comparison projects the original columns, while D0 and N-1
captures include all current columns. Missing or changed original columns,
incomplete output and exceeded bounds refuse.

A fixed administrator-owned probe outside `public` records DDL events. Its
markers are transactional and can roll back; they do not replace independent
statement logs and table digests. Phase boundaries use exact observer records,
zero remaining client sessions, unchanged container/probe bindings and an
append-only log prefix. Every byte between the boundaries is passed to the
existing strict parser. Foreign, unattributed, malformed or partial records
are not filtered away to make a phase pass.

Disposable PG17 validation covers actual inventory/row capture, FORCE RLS,
column projection, empty windows, a rolled-back UPDATE, DDL markers and the
fixed read-only `25006` control. The fixture was removed afterward. This is
collector validation, not a full release compatibility experiment. Catalog
normalization remains the existing Go command's responsibility; the collector
does not invent a second catalog hash or claim production-overlay coverage.

def _preview_rollback(repo, ctx, client, *, git_binary, deadline):
    """Concrete rollback preview for an already validated explicit target."""
    _rollback_context(ctx)
    need(type(deadline) is images._Deadline, "cli-deadline-invalid")
    deadline.remaining()
    resolution = record_resolver.resolve_rollback_proof(client, repo, git_binary, ctx.sha, ctx.target)
    deadline.remaining()
    value = _rollback_snapshot(resolution, ctx)
    deadline.remaining()
    return value


def _execute_rollback(repo, ctx, client, snapshot, *, git_binary, deadline,
                      docker_binary, config_dir, image_work_dir, buildx_binary):
    """Freshly resolve before the private actual engine; no new budget."""
    validate_rollback_snapshot(snapshot, ctx)
    need(type(deadline) is images._Deadline, "cli-deadline-invalid")
    deadline.remaining()
    resolution = record_resolver.resolve_rollback_proof(client, repo, git_binary, ctx.sha, ctx.target)
    need(canonical(_rollback_snapshot(resolution, ctx)) == canonical(snapshot), "cli-resolution-changed")
    deadline.remaining()
    raw = compat._run_rollback_resolved_experiment(repo, resolution, ctx.run_id, ctx.attempt, deadline=deadline,
        docker_binary=docker_binary, config_dir=config_dir, image_work_dir=image_work_dir,
        buildx_binary=buildx_binary)
    validate_rollback_result(raw, snapshot, ctx)
    deadline.remaining()
    return raw


def _read_public(path, *, limit=_MAX_PUBLIC):
    regular_path(path)
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        raw = stream.read(limit + 1)
    need(0 < len(raw) <= limit, "cli-public-bound")
    return raw


def _write_public(path, raw):
    need(type(raw) is bytes and 0 < len(raw) <= _MAX_PUBLIC, "cli-public-bound")
    regular_path(path.parent, directory=True)
    need(not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink(), "cli-public-exists")
    # A partial write never qualifies: caller/aggregator demands canonical
    # complete bytes and this process must succeed before upload is permitted.
    with path.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(raw)


def _write_evidence(directory, result, context_raw, snapshot, ctx):
    validate_evidence(context_raw, result, snapshot, ctx)
    _write_public(directory / "compat-result.json", result)
    _write_public(directory / "compat-context.json", context_raw)
    need({p.name for p in directory.iterdir()} == {"compat-result.json", "compat-context.json"},
         "cli-evidence-inventory")
    written_result = _read_public(directory / "compat-result.json")
    written_context = _read_public(directory / "compat-context.json", limit=_MAX_CONTEXT)
    need(written_result == result and written_context == context_raw, "cli-evidence-written")
    validate_evidence(written_context, written_result, snapshot, ctx)


def _write_rollback_evidence(directory, result, context_raw, snapshot, ctx):
    validate_rollback_evidence(context_raw, result, snapshot, ctx)

    need({p.name for p in directory.iterdir()} == {"compat-result.json", "compat-context.json"},
         "cli-evidence-inventory")
    written_result = _read_public(directory / "compat-result.json")
    written_context = _read_public(directory / "compat-context.json", limit=_MAX_CONTEXT)
    need(written_result == result and written_context == context_raw, "cli-evidence-written")

def _mark_complete(env):
    """A fixed step output permits uploading a measured negative verdict.

    The workflow may upload only after this marker, even if check returns one
    for actual false flags. Infrastructure and partial writes never mark it.
    """
    value = env.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT")
    if value is None:
        return
    path = regular_path(Path(value))
    root = regular_path(Path(env.get("RUNNER_TEMP", "")), directory=True)
    need(path.is_relative_to(root), "cli-output-path-invalid")
    common.Output(stdout=sys.stdout, output_path=str(path)).set_outputs({"complete": "true"})


def _scratch(repo, ctx, phase, env):
    root = regular_path(Path(env.get("RUNNER_TEMP", "")), directory=True)
    need(not root.is_relative_to(repo) and not repo.is_relative_to(root), "cli-scratch-overlap")
    work = root / ("compat-" + phase + "-" + ctx.suffix)
    need(not work.exists(), "cli-already-attempted")
    work.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    for name in ("gh-config", "gh-work", "docker-config", "images", "public"):
        (work / name).mkdir(mode=0o700)
    return work


def _git_binary(env):
    value = env.get("COMPAT_GIT_BIN") or shutil.which("git")
    need(type(value) is str and value, "cli-git-unavailable")
    return regular_path(Path(value))


def _client(work, env, deadline):
    need(type(deadline) is images._Deadline, "cli-deadline-invalid")
    token = env.get("GH_TOKEN")
    need(type(token) is str and 0 < len(token) <= 8192 and not any(c in token for c in "\r\n\0"),
         "cli-token-unavailable")
    binary = regular_path(Path(env.get("COMPAT_GH_BIN", "")))
    def bounded_capture(argv, **options):
        if argv == [str(binary), "--version"]:
            options["timeout"] = min(options["timeout"], 5)
        return runtime.bounded_command(argv, **options)
    budget = record_transport.OperationBudget(deadline.end, capture=bounded_capture, clock=deadline.clock)
    try:
        return record_transport.ReleaseGh(binary, token, work / "gh-config", work / "gh-work",
            budget=budget, base_env=common.scrubbed_env(base=env))
    except Exception:
        budget.close()
        raise

def _diagnostic_code(error):
    args = BaseException.args.__get__(error)
    allowed = (_DIAGNOSTIC_SOURCE_CODES if type(error) is record_resolver.source_git.SourceGitRefusal
               else _DIAGNOSTIC_TRANSPORT_CODES if type(error) is record_transport.TransportRefusal
               else _DIAGNOSTIC_EVIDENCE_CODES if isinstance(error, proof.EvidenceError)
               else _DIAGNOSTIC_RELEASE_CODES if isinstance(error, common.ReleaseError) else ())
    return args[0] if len(args) == 1 and type(args[0]) is str and args[0] in allowed else "unknown"


def _diagnostic_family(error):
    for kind, family in ((proof.InfrastructureFailure, "infrastructure"), (proof.EvidenceError, "evidence"),
                         (common.ReleaseError, "release"), (OSError, "os"), (ValueError, "value"),
                         (TypeError, "type"), (KeyError, "key")):
        if isinstance(error, kind):
            return family
    return "other"


def _diagnostic_phase(error):
    phase = "unknown"
    trace = BaseException.__traceback__.__get__(error)
    for _ in range(64):
        if trace is None:
            return phase
        # Identity, not function name, filename, source text or code equality.
        # The deepest explicitly mapped owner wins; generic transports do not
        # erase the surrounding verification/pull/build/measurement phase.
        for code, label in _DIAGNOSTIC_PHASES:
            if trace.tb_frame.f_code is code:
                phase = label
                break
        trace = trace.tb_next
    return "trace-limit" if trace is not None else phase


def _failure_diagnostic(error):
    parts, seen = [], set()
    for _ in range(4):
        if error is None:
            parts.append("chain=complete")
            break
        if id(error) in seen:
            parts.append("chain=cycle")
            break
        seen.add(id(error))
        parts.append("phase=" + _diagnostic_phase(error) + " family=" + _diagnostic_family(error)
                     + " code=" + _diagnostic_code(error))
        # A suppressed context still carries a fixed diagnostic cause. Read
        # BaseException slots directly: no custom properties, str or repr.
        cause = BaseException.__cause__.__get__(error)
        error = cause if cause is not None else BaseException.__context__.__get__(error)
    else:
        parts.append("chain=complete" if error is None else "chain=limit")
    return "compatibility-diagnostic: " + "; ".join(parts)


def _build_failure_diagnostic(error):
    seen = set()
    for _ in range(4):
        if error is None or id(error) in seen:
            return None
        seen.add(id(error))
        if type(error) is images._BuildFailure:
            value = images._BuildFailure._public(error)
            if value is None:
                return None
            raw = canonical(value)
            if len(raw) <= 1024:
                return "compatibility-build-diagnostic: " + raw.decode('ascii').rstrip('\n')
            return None
        cause = BaseException.__cause__.__get__(error)
        error = cause if cause is not None else BaseException.__context__.__get__(error)
    return None


def _build_progress_diagnostic(deadline):
    value = images._BuildProgress.public(deadline)
    if value is not None:
        raw = canonical(value)
        if len(raw) <= 2048:
            return 'compatibility-build-progress: ' + raw.decode('ascii').rstrip('\n')
    return None


def main(argv=None):
    deadline = None
    try:
        args = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
        need(type(args) is list and len(args) == 1 and type(args[0]) is str
             and args[0] in {"preview", "run", "check", "validate-evidence"}, "cli-command-invalid")
        command = args[0]
        need(images._READY_FOR_EXECUTION, "cli-experiment-disabled")
        ctx = context(os.environ)
        if ctx.target is not None:
            _rollback_context(ctx)
        repo = regular_path(Path.cwd().resolve(), directory=True)
        root = regular_path(Path(os.environ.get("RUNNER_TEMP", "")), directory=True)
        if command == "preview":
            deadline = images._Deadline()
            # Complete historical image verification and immutable-source
            # classification share the existing source-operation 600s ceiling.
            # Establish it before scratch/client work; never reset it later.
            deadline.end = min(deadline.end, deadline.now() + 600)
            work = _scratch(repo, ctx, "preview", os.environ)
            git_binary = _git_binary(os.environ)
            if ctx.target is None:
                value = preview(repo, ctx, _client(work, os.environ, deadline),
                    git_binary=git_binary, deadline=deadline)
            else:
                value = _preview_rollback(repo, ctx, _client(work, os.environ, deadline),
                    git_binary=git_binary, deadline=deadline)
            _write_public(work / "public" / "resolution.json", canonical(value))
            return 1 if value["preview"]["blocked"] else 0
        raw = _read_public(root / "compat-input" / "resolution.json")
        snapshot = common.loads_strict(raw)
        if ctx.target is None:
            need(canonical(validate_snapshot(snapshot, ctx)) == raw, "cli-snapshot-noncanonical")
        else:
            need(canonical(validate_rollback_snapshot(snapshot, ctx)) == raw, "cli-snapshot-noncanonical")
        if command in {"check", "validate-evidence"}:
            need(os.environ.get("COMPAT_PREVIEW_OUTCOME") == "success"
                 and os.environ.get("COMPAT_RUN_OUTCOME") == "success", "cli-upstream-failed")
            result = _read_public(root / "compat-input" / "compat-result.json")
            if ctx.target is None:
                value = validate_result(result, snapshot, ctx)
            else:
                value = validate_rollback_result(result, snapshot, ctx)
            if command == "validate-evidence":
                need({p.name for p in (root / "compat-input").iterdir()}
                     == {"resolution.json", "compat-result.json", "compat-context.json"},
                     "cli-evidence-inventory")
                context_raw = _read_public(root / "compat-input" / "compat-context.json", limit=_MAX_CONTEXT)
                if ctx.target is None:
                    validate_evidence(context_raw, result, snapshot, ctx)
                else:
                    validate_rollback_evidence(context_raw, result, snapshot, ctx)
            else:
                if ctx.target is None:
                    context_raw = canonical(evidence_context(result, snapshot, ctx))
                else:
                    context_raw = canonical(rollback_evidence_context(result, snapshot, ctx))
            work = _scratch(repo, ctx, command, os.environ)
            if ctx.target is None:
                _write_evidence(work / "public", result, context_raw, snapshot, ctx)
            else:
                _write_rollback_evidence(work / "public", result, context_raw, snapshot, ctx)
            _mark_complete(os.environ)
            return 0 if command == "validate-evidence" or accepted(value) else 1
        need(snapshot["preview"]["blocked"] is False, "cli-preview-blocked")
        deadline = images._Deadline()
        work = _scratch(repo, ctx, "run", os.environ)
        docker = regular_path(Path(os.environ.get("COMPAT_DOCKER_BIN", "")))
        plugin = regular_path(Path(os.environ.get("COMPAT_BUILDX_BIN", "")))
        git_binary = _git_binary(os.environ)
        if ctx.target is None:
            result = execute(repo, ctx, _client(work, os.environ, deadline), snapshot,
                git_binary=git_binary, deadline=deadline, docker_binary=str(docker),
                config_dir=work / "docker-config", image_work_dir=work / "images", buildx_binary=plugin)
        else:
            result = _execute_rollback(repo, ctx, _client(work, os.environ, deadline), snapshot,
                git_binary=git_binary, deadline=deadline, docker_binary=str(docker),
                config_dir=work / "docker-config", image_work_dir=work / "images", buildx_binary=plugin)
        _write_public(work / "public" / "compat-result.json", result)
        return 0
    except (proof.EvidenceError, common.ReleaseError, record_resolver.policy.PolicyRefusal,
            OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as error:
        print(_failure_message(error), file=sys.stderr)
        print(_failure_diagnostic(error), file=sys.stderr)
        build_diagnostic = _build_failure_diagnostic(error)
        if build_diagnostic is not None:
            print(build_diagnostic, file=sys.stderr)
        progress = _build_progress_diagnostic(deadline)
        if progress is not None:
            print(progress, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
