def _material(resolution, latest):
    candidate, material = resolution.candidate, resolution.catalog_material
    policy._source(candidate)
    _need(candidate.mode == "reviewed-v0" and type(material) is resolver.CatalogMaterial
          and material.candidate_sha == candidate.sha)
    pins = dict(policy.V0_PINS)
    paths = tuple(sorted(pins))
    _need(type(material.candidate_blobs) is tuple and len(material.candidate_blobs) == len(paths)
          and all(type(row) is policy.SourceBlob and type(row.raw) is bytes
                  and 0 < len(row.raw) <= policy.MAX_SOURCE_FILE_BYTES for row in material.candidate_blobs)
          and tuple(row.path for row in material.candidate_blobs) == paths
          and sum(len(row.raw) for row in material.candidate_blobs) <= policy.MAX_SOURCE_BYTES)
    blobs = {row.path: row.raw for row in material.candidate_blobs}
    artifacts = dict(candidate.artifacts)
    _need(all(common.sha256_bytes(blobs[path]) == pins[path] == artifacts[path] for path in paths))
    profile = common.loads_strict(blobs[policy.PROFILE])
    _need(profile["live_sha256"] == candidate.catalog.catalog_sha256 == policy.V0_MEASUREMENT)
    _need(type(material.baseline_blobs) is tuple and len(material.baseline_blobs) == len(paths)
          and all(type(row) is resolver.BlobObservation for row in material.baseline_blobs)
          and tuple(row.path for row in material.baseline_blobs) == paths)
    absent = ()
    if latest.live is None:
        _need(resolution.database_base_source == latest.record_sha
              and material.baseline_sha == latest.actual_web_source_sha)
        if material.baseline_sha == policy.V0_RELEASED_SOURCE:
            _need(material.baseline_provenance == "legacy-e001-absent-overlay")
            absent = (policy.PROFILE, policy.OVERLAY)
        else:
            _need(material.baseline_provenance == "legacy-equal-reviewed-v0")
        base = evidence.DatabaseBase("legacy-source-only", latest.record_sha, None, None)
    else:
        live = latest.live
        policy._source(live.origin_source)
        _need(live.origin_source.mode == "reviewed-v0" and live.catalog == live.origin_source.catalog
              and resolution.database_base_source == live.origin_source.sha == material.baseline_sha
              and material.baseline_provenance == "retained-live-v2")
        base = evidence.DatabaseBase("retained-live-v2", live.origin_source.sha,
            evidence.OriginIdentity(live.origin_release, live.origin_manifest_sha256),
            evidence.CatalogTuple(*live.catalog))
    for row in material.baseline_blobs:
        _need(row.raw is None if row.path in absent else type(row.raw) is bytes and row.raw == blobs[row.path])
    return base, tuple(evidence.CatalogBlob(path, artifacts[path]) for path in paths)


def _source_base(resolution):
    _need(type(resolution) is resolver.ForwardResolution)
    latest = _chain(resolution.resolved)
    candidate = resolution.candidate
    _need(type(candidate) is policy.SourceFacts and candidate.sha == resolution.resolved.inventory.main_sha)
    for historical in resolution.resolved.chain.sources:
        _need(historical.sha != candidate.sha or historical == candidate)
    base, authority = _material(resolution, latest)
    _need(resolution.previous_web_source_sha == latest.actual_web_source_sha)
    classification = resolution.classification
    _need(type(classification) is resolver.schema_change.PolicyClassification
          and type(classification.kind) is str and type(classification.dormant) is bool)
    for rows in (classification.reasons, classification.summary,
                 classification.migration_changes, classification.requirements):
        _need(type(rows) is tuple and len(rows) <= 8192
              and all(type(value) is str and len(value) <= 8192 for value in rows))
    _need(not classification.reasons
          and classification.requirements == ("compat-required", "generated-migration-closure-ci"))
    _need(type(resolution.workflow) is bytes
          and 0 < len(resolution.workflow) <= policy.MAX_SOURCE_FILE_BYTES
          and common.sha256_bytes(resolution.workflow) == resolution.workflow_sha256)
    return latest, base, authority


def _current_workflow(resolution):
    _need(type(resolution.workflow) is bytes
          and 0 < len(resolution.workflow) <= policy.MAX_SOURCE_FILE_BYTES
          and common.sha256_bytes(resolution.workflow) == resolution.workflow_sha256 == collect.WORKFLOW_SHA256)


def _custody_workflow(resolution):
    # Exact source-owned cases; this does not confer publisher coverage.
    _need(type(resolution.workflow) is bytes
          and 0 < len(resolution.workflow) <= policy.MAX_SOURCE_FILE_BYTES
          and common.sha256_bytes(resolution.workflow) == resolution.workflow_sha256
          and resolution.workflow_sha256 in (W0_WORKFLOW_SHA256, P0_WORKFLOW_SHA256,
                                             collect.WORKFLOW_SHA256))


def _build_request_base(resolution, collected):
    _need(type(resolution) is resolver.ForwardResolution and type(collected) is collect.CollectedHistory)
    latest, base, authority = _source_base(resolution)
    candidate, classification = resolution.candidate, resolution.classification
    _need(type(collected.history) is evidence.VisibleHistory
          and collected.history.sha == candidate.sha
          and type(collected.issues) is tuple
          and all(value in ("artifact-unverified", "inventory-changed", "inventory-unavailable", "collection-deadline")
                  for value in collected.issues)
          and type(collected.command_count) is int and 0 < collected.command_count <= collect.MAX_COMMANDS
          and type(collected.captured_bytes) is int and 0 <= collected.captured_bytes <= collect.MAX_BYTES
          and type(collected.transcript_sha256) is str and common.SHA256_RE.fullmatch(collected.transcript_sha256))
    identity = evidence.ReleaseIdentity(latest.release, latest.manifest_sha256,
                                        latest.record_sha, dict(latest.images)["web"])
    source = evidence.SourceFacts(candidate.sha, identity,
        evidence.Classification(classification.kind, classification.dormant, classification.reasons),
        candidate.catalog.catalog_sha256, authority, base, latest.actual_web_source_sha)
    request = evidence.NormalRequest(source, identity, collected.history.observation_id)
    evidence._history(collected.history, candidate.sha, request.observation_id)
    return request


def _pending_projection(resolution):
    active = {row.path: row.raw for row in resolution.catalog_material.candidate_blobs}
    projection = pending_source.replay(resolution.pending,
        candidate_sha=resolution.candidate.sha, previous_sha=resolution.resolved.latest.record_sha,
        active_catalog=active[policy.GOLDEN], active_globals=active[policy.GLOBALS],
        active_history=active[policy.HISTORY])
    _need(projection.plan is None or all(entry.kind == "expand" for entry in projection.plan.entries))
    return projection


def _bind_pending_request(resolution, request):
    projection = _pending_projection(resolution)
    request = replace(request, source=replace(request.source, pending_binding=projection.binding))
    evidence._request(request)
    return request


def _build_request(resolution, collected):
    request = _build_request_base(resolution, collected)
    _current_workflow(resolution)
    return _bind_pending_request(resolution, request)


def _build_context3_custody_request(resolution, collected):
    request = _build_request_base(resolution, collected)
    _custody_workflow(resolution)
    return _bind_pending_request(resolution, request)


def _build_context2_custody_request(resolution, collected):
    _need(type(resolution) is resolver.ForwardResolution and resolution.pending is None)
    request = _build_request_base(resolution, collected)
    _need(resolution.workflow_sha256 == W0_WORKFLOW_SHA256)
    evidence._request_context2_custody(request)
    return request


def _fixed_build(function, resolution, collected):
    try:
        return function(resolution, collected)
    except evidence.CompatRefusal:
        raise
    except (policy.PolicyRefusal, common.ReleaseError, ValueError, TypeError,
            AttributeError, KeyError, IndexError, RecursionError, OverflowError):
        raise evidence.CompatRefusal("compat-stale", "request-resolution-invalid") from None


def build_request(resolution, collected) -> evidence.NormalRequest:
    """Project exact bound data, preserving the collector's observation ID.

    Qualification remains separate: an older unverified artifact issue may be
    safely superseded under the existing execution-window policy. No blanket
    issues-empty condition or new history/negative policy is introduced here.
    """
    return _fixed_build(_build_request, resolution, collected)


def qualify(resolution, collected) -> evidence.QualifiedCompat:
    """Use the existing normal policy; never a rollback/bypass authorization."""
    return evidence.require_compat(build_request(resolution, collected), collected.history)


def _qualify_context2_custody(resolution, collected) -> evidence.QualifiedCompat:
    """Exact old context2 replay, solely for closed original same-run custody.

    No current source resolver yields pending=None. The codec/writer must bind
    the original wire version, execution and parent before choosing this path;
    a Python object or call here does not authenticate those external facts.
    """
    request = _fixed_build(_build_context2_custody_request, resolution, collected)
    return evidence._require_context2_custody(request, collected.history)


def _qualify_context3_custody(resolution, collected) -> evidence.QualifiedCompat:
    """Closed original context3 replay, never current workflow admission."""
    request = _fixed_build(_build_context3_custody_request, resolution, collected)
    return evidence.require_compat(request, collected.history)


def _validate_source_material(resolution):
    projection = _pending_projection(resolution)
    contract = compat_catalog.CatalogContract.from_resolution(resolution)
    _need(contract.pending_binding == projection.binding)
    change = resolution.classification
    _need((change.kind == "none" and not change.dormant)
          or (change.kind == "data" and change.dormant)
          or (change.kind == "expand" and change.dormant and projection.binding.target_version is not None))
    resolver.validate_forward_audit(resolution.audit, candidate_sha=resolution.candidate.sha,
        database_base_source=resolution.database_base_source,
        latest_record_sha=resolution.resolved.latest.record_sha,
        selected_web_source_sha=resolution.resolved.selected.actual_web_source_sha)
    recipe = resolution.previous_recipe
    _need(type(recipe) is resolver.WebRecipe and recipe.path == resolver._WEB_RECIPE
          and recipe.source_sha == resolution.previous_web_source_sha
          and type(recipe.raw) is bytes and 0 < len(recipe.raw) <= policy.MAX_SOURCE_FILE_BYTES
          and common.sha256_bytes(recipe.raw) == recipe.sha256)
    return resolution


def validate_current_source(resolution):
    """Pure source validation; no fabricated collection or availability fact."""
    try:
        _source_base(resolution)
        _current_workflow(resolution)
        return _validate_source_material(resolution)
    except evidence.CompatRefusal:
        raise
    except (compat_catalog.proof.EvidenceError, policy.PolicyRefusal, common.ReleaseError,
            ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError, KeyError, IndexError, RecursionError, OverflowError):
        raise evidence.CompatRefusal("compat-stale", "request-resolution-invalid") from None


def _validate_source_custody(resolution):
    """Exact preserved source replay only; old workflow is not index coverage."""
    try:
        _source_base(resolution)
        _custody_workflow(resolution)
        return _validate_source_material(resolution)
    except evidence.CompatRefusal:
        raise
    except (compat_catalog.proof.EvidenceError, policy.PolicyRefusal, common.ReleaseError,
            ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError, KeyError, IndexError, RecursionError, OverflowError):
        raise evidence.CompatRefusal("compat-stale", "request-resolution-invalid") from None


def _build_rollback_request(resolution, collected):
    # Reuse the complete source/material validator before deriving a compact
    # commitment. Neither the digest nor a typed resolution authenticates the
    # source, signed chain, or its currentness outside the concrete operation.
    contract = compat_catalog.CatalogContract.from_rollback_resolution(resolution)
    material = resolver.rollback_material_digest(resolution)
    latest, selected = resolution.resolved.latest, resolution.resolved.selected
    required = resolution.requirements
    live = required.live
    identity = lambda row: evidence.ReleaseIdentity(row.release, row.manifest_sha256,
                                                    row.record_sha, dict(row.images)['web'])
    binding = evidence.RollbackBinding(resolution.producer.sha, identity(latest), identity(selected),
        evidence.DatabaseBase('retained-live-v2', live.origin_source.sha,
            evidence.OriginIdentity(live.origin_release, live.origin_manifest_sha256),
            evidence.CatalogTuple(*live.catalog)), selected.actual_web_source_sha,
        latest.actual_web_source_sha,
        evidence.RollbackSpan(len(required.span), required.non_none_count, required.span_sha256), material)
    # This complete pure replay also validates all-head coverage, raw history
    # bounds and the collected metadata. Artifact issues stay available to the
    # qualification policy; they are not a blanket veto on earlier known work.
    rollback_history.validate_collected(collected)
    history = collected.history
    _need(history.producer_sha == binding.producer_sha
          and contract.catalog_control_sha == binding.producer_sha
          and contract.target_sha256 == binding.database_base.catalog.catalog_sha256)
    observed = next((row for row in history.workflows if row.sha == binding.producer_sha), None)
    _need(observed is not None and observed.raw == resolution.workflow)
    return rollback_history.validate_request(rollback_history.RollbackRequest(
        binding, resolution.workflow, history.observation_id))


def build_rollback_request(resolution, collected) -> rollback_history.RollbackRequest:
    """Project a fresh internally resolved exact rollback span, without I/O.

    The future caller must own concrete resolution/collection and final source
    freshness before effects. This function adds no operational permission or
    deleted-history coverage and never treats context bytes as source input.
    """
    try:
        return _build_rollback_request(resolution, collected)
    except evidence.CompatRefusal:
        raise
    except (compat_catalog.proof.EvidenceError, policy.PolicyRefusal, common.ReleaseError,
            ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError, KeyError, IndexError, RecursionError, OverflowError):
        raise evidence.CompatRefusal('compat-stale', 'rollback-request-resolution-invalid') from None


def qualify_rollback(resolution, collected) -> rollback_history.QualifiedRollback:
    """Apply dedicated all-head policy; never return a RollbackDecision."""
    request = build_rollback_request(resolution, collected)
    return rollback_history.require_rollback_compat(request, collected.history)

            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("rollback-proof-source-unsupported")

        for path in policy.SOURCE_PATHS:

            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
        grouped.setdefault(sha, []).append(role)
    return tuple((sha, tuple(roles)) for sha, roles in sorted(grouped.items()))


def validate_forward_audit(audit, *, candidate_sha, database_base_source,
                           latest_record_sha, selected_web_source_sha):
    """Check a complete immutable projection; this cannot authenticate bytes.

    The diff cap covers the complete canonical range projection. Drill bytes
    retain the existing source-file cap and are not interpreted here: malformed
    irrelevant drill metadata must not accidentally become a required gate.
    """
    def need(ok):
        if not ok:
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")

    need(type(candidate_sha) is str and common.SHA1_RE.fullmatch(candidate_sha) is not None)
    need(type(audit) is ForwardAuditMaterial and audit.candidate_sha == candidate_sha)
    need(type(audit.drills) is BlobObservation and audit.drills.path == _DRILLS
         and (audit.drills.raw is None or (type(audit.drills.raw) is bytes
              and len(audit.drills.raw) <= policy.MAX_SOURCE_FILE_BYTES)))
    expected = _audit_roles(database_base_source, latest_record_sha, selected_web_source_sha)
    need(type(audit.changes) is tuple and len(audit.changes) == len(expected))
    projection = []
    for row, (base, roles) in zip(audit.changes, expected, strict=True):
        need(type(row) is ChangedRange and type(row.roles) is tuple and row.roles == roles
             and row.base_sha == base and row.head_sha == candidate_sha
             and type(row.rows) is tuple and len(row.rows) <= MAX_CHANGED_PATHS)
        paths = []
        for item in row.rows:
            need(type(item) is ChangedPath and type(item.status) is str
                 and item.status in ("A", "D", "M", "T", "U", "X")
                 and source_git._path(item.path))
            paths.append(item.path)
        need(paths == sorted(set(paths)))
        need(base != candidate_sha or not row.rows)
        projection.append({"roles": roles, "base_sha": base, "head_sha": candidate_sha,
                           "rows": [(item.status, item.path) for item in row.rows]})
    need(len(common.canonical_file_bytes(projection)) <= MAX_AUDIT_BYTES)
    return audit


def _forward_audit(reader, repo_dir, latest, selected, candidate_sha, database_base):
    drills = BlobObservation(_DRILLS, reader.read_blob(candidate_sha, _DRILLS))
    changes = []
    for base, roles in _audit_roles(database_base, latest.record_sha, selected.actual_web_source_sha):
        raw = reader.output(repo_dir, ["diff", "--no-renames", "--name-status", "-z",
                            base, candidate_sha, "--"], code="git-failed:source-audit")
        if type(raw) is not bytes or (raw and not raw.endswith(b"\0")):
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
        fields = raw.split(b"\0")[:-1] if raw else []
        if len(fields) % 2 or len(fields) > MAX_CHANGED_PATHS * 2:
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
        rows = tuple(ChangedPath(fields[i].decode("ascii"), fields[i + 1].decode("utf-8"))
                     for i in range(0, len(fields), 2))
        changes.append(ChangedRange(roles, base, candidate_sha,
                                    tuple(sorted(rows, key=lambda item: item.path))))
    return validate_forward_audit(ForwardAuditMaterial(candidate_sha, drills, tuple(changes)),
        candidate_sha=candidate_sha, database_base_source=database_base,
        latest_record_sha=latest.record_sha, selected_web_source_sha=selected.actual_web_source_sha)


def _forward_pending(reader, repo_dir, latest_sha, candidate_sha, database_base, material, classification):
    """Retain complete observations; malformed plans stay blocked previews.

    Endpoint capture/framing/mode/bounds failures are hard resolver refusals.
    Complete observed invalid plans and intermediate history remain explicitly
    blocked previews; no raw endpoint bytes are omitted or replaced by absence.
    """
    active = {row.path: row.raw for row in material.candidate_blobs}
    active_args = dict(active_catalog=active[policy.GOLDEN], active_globals=active[policy.GLOBALS],
                       active_history=active[policy.HISTORY])
    inventories = {}
    for sha in sorted({candidate_sha, latest_sha}):
        raw = reader.output(repo_dir, ["ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "-z", sha, "--",
                            pending_source.plan.PREFIX.rstrip("/")], code="git-failed:source-pending")
        if type(raw) is not bytes or len(raw) > pending_source.MAX_FILE_BYTES or (raw and not raw.endswith(b"\0")):
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
        names = raw[:-1].decode("utf-8").split("\0") if raw else []
        if (len(names) > 3 or names != sorted(set(names))
                or any(pending_source._FILE.fullmatch(name) is None for name in names)):
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
        files = []
        for path in names:
            body = reader.read_blob(sha, path)
            if type(body) is not bytes or not 0 < len(body) <= pending_source.MAX_FILE_BYTES:
                raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
            files.append(pending_source.PendingBlob(path, body))
        inventories[sha] = tuple(files)
    pending = pending_source.PendingMaterial(candidate_sha, latest_sha,
        inventories[candidate_sha], inventories[latest_sha])
    if (sum(len(raw) for raw in active_args.values())
            + sum(len(row.raw) for rows in (pending.candidate_files, pending.previous_files) for row in rows)
            > pending_source.MAX_MATERIAL_BYTES):
        raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
    reasons, requirements = set(classification.reasons), set(classification.requirements)
    summary = [line for line in classification.summary if not line.startswith("policy classification:")]
    kind, dormant = classification.kind, classification.dormant
    if latest_sha != database_base:
        # Rollback can separate latest source from database origin. Endpoint
        # hashes cannot reveal a transient plan removal/replacement on this
        # second range. Reuse only the bounded pending traversal, not a second
        # complete classifier. Its reads share the original Git/outer budgets.
        range_reasons, range_requirements, range_summary = set(), set(), []
        try:
            introduced = schema_change._v2_pending(schema_change._Repository(repo_dir), latest_sha,
                candidate_sha, range_reasons, range_summary, range_requirements)
            if introduced and kind == "none":
                kind, dormant = "expand", True
        except (schema_change._Invalid, UnicodeError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError, RecursionError):
            reasons.add("classifier-v2-invalid:pending-latest-record")
            requirements.update(("pending-format-unsupported", "producer-class-unsupported"))
        reasons.update(range_reasons)
        requirements.update(range_requirements)
        summary.extend(line for line in range_summary if line not in summary)
    try:
        projection = pending_source.replay(pending, candidate_sha=candidate_sha, previous_sha=latest_sha, **active_args)
        if projection.plan is not None and any(entry.kind != "expand" for entry in projection.plan.entries):
            reasons.add("pending-format-unsupported")
            requirements.update(("pending-format-unsupported", "producer-class-unsupported"))
    except pending_source.PendingSourceRefusal:
        reasons.update(("pending-format-unsupported", "classifier-v2-invalid:pending-material"))
        requirements.update(("pending-format-unsupported", "producer-class-unsupported"))
    summary.append("policy classification: " + kind + (" (dormant)" if dormant else ""))
    if len(summary) > 25000:
        raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
    for line in (*reasons, *summary):
        common.require_public_text(line)
    classification = schema_change.PolicyClassification(kind, dormant, tuple(sorted(reasons)), tuple(summary),
        classification.migration_changes, tuple(sorted(requirements)))
    return pending, classification


# These endpoint pins come from the reviewed source-only production blueprint,
# not from an observed graph or application-golden catalog. Version 1 below is
# planned source intent only; active source and live coordinates stay at v0.
_NULLABLE_PREFIX = "internal/dbcatalog/profiles/nullable-column-v1/"
_NULLABLE_BEFORE = "1c85a9ad0b9bb652ea21b51faa2ee887592dacb00c7f4b388de5ef5d6085a4e7"
_NULLABLE_AFTER = "a8f15ea159883aacdeecd3c55100f3b589f10ca18708ba113a393805cbf9948e"
_NULLABLE_OPERATION = "c775d31243e85e933598b06d3828cc329460902b27d1f0f1a9b2b62a022424d2"
_NULLABLE_DESCRIPTOR = "0d20f14c144d0230d4afb2b98b9bf106bc08577c69160af41dc014d8ebafa946"
_NULLABLE_SLOTS = (
    ("before", "catalog-v0.json", 4 << 20, _NULLABLE_BEFORE),
    ("candidate_baseline", "catalog-v0.json", 4 << 20, _NULLABLE_BEFORE),
    ("candidate_probe", "probe-operation.json", 2 << 10, _NULLABLE_OPERATION),
    ("descriptor", "transition-v1.json", 16 << 10, _NULLABLE_DESCRIPTOR),
    ("operation", "operation-v1.json", 2 << 10, _NULLABLE_OPERATION),
    ("after", "catalog-v1.json", 4 << 20, _NULLABLE_AFTER),
)


def _nullable_sources(reader, budget, latest, candidate):
    """Collect six fixed slots without manufacturing legacy live metadata.

    Every present slot is validated, even on an unavailable path. Endpoint
    pins do not assert profile namespace history or a named migration step.
    """
    def need(condition):
        if not condition:
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("nullable-profile-incomplete")

    def current_v0(source):
        return (source.mode == "reviewed-v0" and source.catalog is not None
                and source.catalog.catalog_version == 0
                and source.catalog.min_reader_version == 0
                and source.catalog.catalog_sha256 == _NULLABLE_BEFORE)

    budget.check()
    need(current_v0(candidate))
    live = latest.live
    if live is not None:
        need(current_v0(live.origin_source) and live.catalog == live.origin_source.catalog)
    before_sha = latest.record_sha if live is None else live.origin_source.sha
    provenance = "legacy-record-only" if live is None else "live-origin"
    observations, total = [], 0
    for slot, suffix, limit, _pin in _NULLABLE_SLOTS:
        sha = before_sha if slot == "before" else candidate.sha
        path = _NULLABLE_PREFIX + suffix
        raw = reader.read_blob(sha, path)
        if raw is not None:
            need(type(raw) is bytes and 0 < len(raw) <= limit)
            total += len(raw)
            # Count logical roles including duplicate SHA/path/raw before any
            # decoding. AG independently retains its own four-slot limit.
            need(total <= 8 << 20)
        observations.append(NullableSourceObservation(slot, sha, path, raw))
    budget.check()
    for row, (_slot, _suffix, _limit, pin) in zip(observations, _NULLABLE_SLOTS, strict=True):
        if row.raw is None:
            continue
        need(common.sha256_bytes(row.raw) == pin)
        if row.slot in ("before", "candidate_baseline", "after"):
            nullable._catalog(row.raw)
        elif row.slot in ("candidate_probe", "operation"):
            nullable.semantic.parse_operation(row.raw)
        else:
            # Canonical closed document decoding plus the exact reviewed pin
            # validates this present descriptor without inventing an origin.
            nullable._fields(nullable.wire._load(row.raw, nullable.MAX_DESCRIPTOR),
                ("format_version", "profile", "postgres_major", "observation_version",
                 "default_acl_contract_sha256", "renderer", "operation", "before", "after"))
    before, baseline, probe, descriptor, operation, after = observations
    plans = (descriptor.raw is not None, operation.raw is not None, after.raw is not None)
    need(all(plans) or not any(plans))
    need((baseline.raw is None) == (probe.raw is None))
    need(not any(plans) or baseline.raw is not None)
    if before.raw is not None and baseline.raw is not None:
        need(before.raw == baseline.raw)
    unavailable = tuple(code for code, absent in (
        ("legacy-live-unavailable", live is None),
        ("origin-profile-missing", before.raw is None),
        ("candidate-plan-missing", not any(plans))) if absent)
    target = nullable.CatalogCoordinates(1, 0, _NULLABLE_AFTER) if all(plans) else None
    material = bound = None
    if all(plans) and before.raw is not None:
        material = nullable.ProfileMaterial(*(nullable.SourceBlob(row.source_sha, row.path, row.raw)
            for row in (descriptor, operation, before, after)))
    if not unavailable:
        origin = nullable.RetainedOrigin(live.origin_release, live.origin_manifest_sha256,
            before_sha, nullable.CatalogCoordinates(0, 0, live.catalog.catalog_sha256))
        bound = nullable.bind_source_profile(origin,
            nullable.CandidateSource(candidate.sha, target), material)
    budget.check()
    return before_sha, provenance, tuple(observations), unavailable, target, material, bound


def _resolve_nullable_profile(client: transport.ReleaseGh, repo_dir: Path,
                              git_binary: Path, candidate_sha: str) -> NullableProfilePreparation:
    """Private source preparation; no observations, transition or main authority."""
    return _resolve(client, repo_dir, git_binary, None, candidate_sha,
                    forward=True, nullable_profile=True)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PublisherAncestry:
    producer_sha: str
    head_sha: str
    merge_base_sha: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PublisherBlob:
    source_sha: str
    path: str
    mode: str | None
    raw: bytes | None = field(repr=False)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PublisherNamespace:
    source_sha: str
    raw: bytes = field(repr=False)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SourceCoverage:
    policy_raw: bytes = field(repr=False)
    policy_blob: BlobObservation = field(repr=False)
    ancestry: tuple[PublisherAncestry, ...]
    blobs: tuple[PublisherBlob, ...] = field(repr=False)
    namespaces: tuple[PublisherNamespace, ...] = field(repr=False)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OutageForwardResolution:
    admission: ForwardAdmission = field(repr=False)
    coverage: SourceCoverage = field(repr=False)


def resolve_outage_forward(client: transport.ReleaseGh, repo_dir: Path,
                           git_binary: Path, candidate_sha: str) -> OutageForwardResolution:
    """Capture configured lineage data within the original source operation.

    Noncoverage is data until outage is selected. No source fact or Python
    holder supplies signature authority, and no new allowance is created.
    """
    return _resolve(client, repo_dir, git_binary, None, candidate_sha,
                    forward=True, admission=True, outage=True)


def _outage_blob(reader, budget, sha, path, remaining):
    import compat_negative_index as index
    raw = reader.output(reader.repo, ["ls-tree", "-z", sha, "--", path], code="unused")
    if not raw:
        return PublisherBlob(sha, path, None, None)
    rows = raw.split(b"\0")
    meta, sep, name = rows[0].partition(b"\t")
    mode, kind, oid = meta.split(b" ")
    if (len(rows) != 2 or rows[1] or not sep or name != path.encode("ascii")
            or mode not in (b"100644", b"100755") or kind != b"blob"
            or common.SHA1_RE.fullmatch(oid.decode("ascii")) is None):
        budget.fail("outage-source")
    size = reader.output(reader.repo, ["cat-file", "-s", oid.decode("ascii")], code="unused").strip()
    if not size.isdigit() or not 0 <= int(size) <= min(index.MAX_SOURCE, remaining):
        budget.fail("outage-source-bound")
    value = reader.output(reader.repo, ["cat-file", "blob", oid.decode("ascii")], code="unused")
    if len(value) != int(size):
        budget.fail("outage-source")
    return PublisherBlob(sha, path, mode.decode("ascii"), value)


def _outage_sources(reader, budget, candidate_sha):
    import compat_outage_policy as loader
    import compat_negative_index as index
    installed = loader.require_consumer_policy()
    policy_blob = _outage_blob(reader, budget, candidate_sha, loader.DATA_PATH, index.MAX_CONFIG)
    if policy_blob.raw != installed.raw:
        budget.fail("outage-policy-source")
    ancestors, blobs, namespaces, total = [], [], [], 0
    for lineage in installed.lineage:
        producer = lineage.producer_sha
        if reader.output(reader.repo, ["cat-file", "-t", producer], code="unused") != b"commit\n":
            budget.fail("outage-producer")
        raw = reader.output(reader.repo, ["merge-base", producer, candidate_sha], code="unused")
        if len(raw) != 41 or raw[-1:] != b"\n" or common.SHA1_RE.fullmatch(raw[:-1].decode("ascii")) is None:
            budget.fail("outage-ancestry")
        ancestors.append(PublisherAncestry(producer, candidate_sha, raw[:-1].decode("ascii")))
        for sha in (producer, candidate_sha):
            namespace = reader.output(reader.repo, [*source_git._PUBLISHER_TREE_ARGS, sha, "--",
                *source_git._PUBLISHER_PATHS], code="unused")
            total += len(namespace)
            if total > index.MAX_SOURCE_TOTAL:
                budget.fail("outage-source-bound")
            namespaces.append(PublisherNamespace(sha, namespace))
        for row in lineage.inventory:
            for sha in (producer, candidate_sha):
                blob = _outage_blob(reader, budget, sha, row.path, index.MAX_SOURCE_TOTAL - total)
                total += len(blob.raw) if blob.raw is not None else 0
                blobs.append(blob)
    # Parse only after every logical namespace/blob byte has been charged.
    # Ineligible but well-framed topology is retained for possible normal proof;
    # malformed or truncated captured metadata still poisons this source read.
    for namespace in namespaces:
        source_git.publisher_namespace(namespace.raw)
    budget.check()
    return SourceCoverage(installed.raw, BlobObservation(loader.DATA_PATH, policy_blob.raw),
                          tuple(ancestors), tuple(blobs), tuple(namespaces))


def _resolve(client, repo_dir, git_binary, selected_tag, candidate_sha, *, forward, rollback=False,
             admission=False, rollback_proof=False, nullable_profile=False, rollback_admission=False, outage=False):
    if type(client) is not transport.ReleaseGh or type(client.budget) is not transport.OperationBudget:
        raise transport.TransportRefusal("record-chain-invalid:resolver-client")
    budget = client.budget
    try:
        if budget.profile == "normal-admission" and not (
                forward is True and admission is True and selected_tag is None
                and rollback is False and rollback_proof is False
                and nullable_profile is False and rollback_admission is False and outage is False):
            budget.fail("resolver-profile")
        if outage and (not forward or not admission or rollback or rollback_proof
                       or nullable_profile or rollback_admission or selected_tag is not None):
            budget.fail("resolver-selection")
        if rollback_admission and (forward or rollback or admission or rollback_proof
                                   or nullable_profile or selected_tag is None):
            budget.fail("resolver-selection")
        if nullable_profile and (not forward or rollback or admission or rollback_proof or selected_tag is not None):
            budget.fail("resolver-selection")
        if admission and (not forward or rollback or selected_tag is not None):
            budget.fail("resolver-selection")
        if rollback and (forward or selected_tag is None):
            budget.fail("resolver-selection")
        if rollback_proof and (forward or rollback or admission or selected_tag is None):
            budget.fail("resolver-selection")
        if (forward or rollback_proof or rollback_admission) and (type(candidate_sha) is not str or common.SHA1_RE.fullmatch(candidate_sha) is None):
            budget.fail("resolver-candidate")
        if selected_tag is not None and (type(selected_tag) is not str or
                (selected_tag != common.BOOTSTRAP_TAG and common.RECORD_TAG_RE.fullmatch(selected_tag) is None)):
            budget.fail("resolver-selection")
        snapshot = client.capture_snapshot()
        if (admission or rollback_proof) and candidate_sha != snapshot.main_sha:
            budget.fail("resolver-main")
        bootstrap = records.load_bootstrap()
        bootstrap_raw = common.canonical_file_bytes(bootstrap)
        # Consume the entire inventory before deriving policy. Each yielded
        # value has already passed the existing canonical/signature checks.
        raw_records = tuple(records.collect_authenticated_records(client, work_dir=client.work_dir))
        documents = (bootstrap, *(records.validate_manifest(common.loads_strict(row.raw)) for row in raw_records))
        proof_lane = rollback_proof
        if rollback_admission:
            # This provisional wire count only plans complete source loading.
            # Full normalization, exact target and every intermediate guard
            # below determine the returned lane. It supplies no policy facts.
            positions = [index for index, row in enumerate(documents) if row['release'] == selected_tag]
            if len(positions) != 1:
                budget.fail("resolver-selection")
            proof_lane = (documents[-1]['schema_version'] == 2 and
                sum(records.manifest_facts(row).db_change != 'none' for row in documents[positions[0] + 1:]) >= 2)
            if proof_lane and candidate_sha != snapshot.main_sha:
                budget.fail("resolver-main")
        images = (client.verify_selected_images(None),
                  *(client.verify_selected_images(row) for row in raw_records))
        for document, binding in zip(documents, images, strict=True):
            expected_images = tuple((key, document["images"][key]) for key in common.COMPONENTS)
            expected_sources = tuple((key, bootstrap["legacy_signer"]["source_commit"]
                if document["images"][key] == bootstrap["images"][key] else document["sha"])
                for key in common.COMPONENTS)
            if (type(binding) is not transport.VerifiedImages or binding.release != document["release"]
                    or binding.record_sha != document["sha"] or binding.images != expected_images
                    or binding.source_shas != expected_sources):
                budget.fail("resolver-images")
        legacy, required, readers, commits = _source_requirements(documents, images)
        if forward or proof_lane:
            # Plan this before any facts are decoded: the candidate may be a
            # SHA already seen in the historical v1 prefix. Its complete
            # contract must win there too, with one consistent SourceFacts.
            required.add(candidate_sha)
            commits.add(candidate_sha)
        if budget.profile == "normal-admission":
            reader = source_git.ImmutableGit(repo_dir, git_binary,
                limits=source_git.Limits(seconds=budget.remaining()), capture=budget.capture,
                clock=budget.clock, profile="normal-admission")
        else:
            reader = source_git.ImmutableGit(repo_dir, git_binary,
                limits=source_git.Limits(seconds=budget.remaining()), capture=budget.capture, clock=budget.clock)
        with reader.operation():
            for sha in sorted(commits):
                if reader.output(repo_dir, ["cat-file", "-t", sha], code="git-failed:source-commit") != b"commit\n":
                    budget.fail("resolver-commit")
            facts = []
            for sha in sorted(readers | required):
                if sha in required:
                    # A missing/unsupported complete contract cannot fall back
                    # to reader0, even if this SHA also appears in the v1 prefix.
                    facts.append(reader.reviewed_v0(sha))
                elif sha in legacy:
                    facts.append(policy.legacy_reader0(sha))
                else:
                    budget.fail("resolver-source")
            ancestors = []
            for prior, current in zip(documents, documents[1:]):
                pair = prior["sha"], current["sha"]
                if current["kind"] == "promote" and pair[0] != pair[1] and pair not in ancestors:
                    if reader.output(repo_dir, ["merge-base", *pair], code="git-failed:source-ancestry") != (pair[0] + "\n").encode("ascii"):
                        budget.fail("resolver-ancestry")
                    ancestors.append(pair)
            raw = (bootstrap_raw, *(row.raw for row in raw_records))
            inputs = tuple(policy.RecordInput(data, common.sha256_bytes(data), dict(binding.source_shas)["web"])
                           for data, binding in zip(raw, images, strict=True))
            chain = policy.normalize_chain(inputs, tuple(facts), tuple(ancestors))
            if not chain.runtime_source_supported or chain.baseline is not None:
                budget.fail("resolver-source")
            latest = _selection(chain, len(chain.entries) - 1)
            tag = latest.release if selected_tag is None else selected_tag
            matches = [index for index, entry in enumerate(chain.entries) if entry.release == tag]
            if len(matches) != 1:
                budget.fail("resolver-selection")
            selected = _selection(chain, matches[0])
            if forward:
                candidate = next(fact for fact in facts if fact.sha == candidate_sha)
                candidate, classification, workflow, database_base = _forward_source(
                    reader, repo_dir, latest, candidate)
                material = _catalog_material(reader, latest, selected, candidate)
                recipe = _web_recipe(reader, selected)
                audit = _forward_audit(reader, repo_dir, latest, selected, candidate_sha, database_base)
                pending, classification = _forward_pending(reader, repo_dir, latest.record_sha, candidate_sha,
                    database_base, material, classification)
                observation = None
                if admission and classification.kind == "contract":
                    if classification.dormant is not False:
                        raise contract.ContractRefusal("contract-label-classification")
                    observation = contract_collect.collect_contract(client, candidate_sha,
                        wall_clock=_contract_now)
                    if (type(observation) is not contract.ContractObservation
                            or type(observation.observed_at) is not datetime
                            or observation.observed_at.tzinfo is not timezone.utc
                            or observation.observed_at.fold != 0):
                        raise contract.ContractRefusal("contract-label-observation-time")
                    contract.require_contract_label(observation, candidate_sha=candidate_sha,
                        repository_id=transport.REPOSITORY_ID, now=observation.observed_at)
            if rollback or (rollback_admission and not proof_lane):
                legacy_chain, legacy_classification, decision = _rollback_source(chain, repo_dir, tag)
            if proof_lane:
                producer = next(fact for fact in facts if fact.sha == candidate_sha)
                requirements, workflow, materials, target_recipe, live_recipe = _rollback_proof_source(

                "command-failed": "command-nonzero", "signature": "signature",
                "image-verification": "signature", "bound": "bound",
            }.get(detail, "other")

        raise _failure(detail) from None

def _logical_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:
    lines: list[str] = []
    current = ""
    for raw in text.split("\n"):
        stripped = raw.strip()
        if not current and (not stripped or stripped.startswith("#")):
            continue
        if raw.rstrip().endswith("\\"):
            current += raw.rstrip()[:-1] + " "
            continue
        current += raw
        lines.append(current.strip())
        current = ""
    if current.strip():
        lines.append(current.strip())

def check_dockerfile_pins(repo_dir: Path, component: str) -> str:

    FROM is name@sha256 (or scratch, or an earlier stage), every remote ADD
    carries --checksum, and COPY/RUN --from only names earlier stages."""
    code = "dockerfile-pin-invalid"
    relative = DOCKERFILES[component]
    path = repo_dir / relative

    ).split(b"\x00") if item]

        common.fail(code)

    if hashed != fields[2]:
        common.fail(code)

    try:
        text = raw.decode("ascii")
    except UnicodeError as exc:
        raise common.ReleaseError(code) from exc
    if "\r" in text:
        common.fail(code)
    first = text.lstrip("\n").split("\n", 1)[0].replace(" ", "").lower()
    if first.startswith("#syntax=") or first.startswith("#escape=") or first.startswith("#check="):
        common.fail(code)

    for line in _logical_lines(text):

        if instruction == "FROM":
            saw_from = True

                common.fail(code)

                common.fail(code)
            if not (image == "scratch" or image.lower() in stages or PINNED_FROM_RE.fullmatch(image)):
                common.fail(code)
            if len(rest) == 3:
                stages.add(rest[2].lower())
        elif instruction == "ADD":
            sources = [item for item in arguments if not item.startswith("--")]
            remote = [item for item in sources[:-1] if "://" in item or item.startswith("git@")]
            checksums = [item for item in arguments if item.startswith("--checksum")]
            if remote:
                if len(remote) != 1 or not remote[0].startswith("https://"):
                    common.fail(code)
                if len(checksums) != 1 or CHECKSUM_RE.fullmatch(checksums[0]) is None:
                    common.fail(code)
        elif instruction in {"COPY", "RUN"}:
            for item in arguments:
                if not item.startswith("--"):
                    break
                if item.startswith("--from="):
                    if item[len("--from="):].lower() not in stages:
                        common.fail(code)
                elif item.startswith("--mount="):
                    for part in item[len("--mount="):].split(","):
                        key, _, value = part.partition("=")
                        if key == "from" and value.lower() not in stages:
                            common.fail(code)
        elif instruction == "ONBUILD":
            common.fail(code)
    if not saw_from:
        common.fail(code)
    return common.sha256_bytes(raw)


def _scan_dir(ctx: Context) -> Path:
    path = ctx.runner_temp() / "ship-scan"
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_dir():
        common.fail("artifact-invalid:scan-dir")
    return path


def _image_identity(ctx: Context, component: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    image = ctx.env.get("IMAGE")
    if image != common.IMAGE_REPOSITORY[component]:
        common.fail("image-contract-differs:image")
    digest = common.require_digest(ctx.env.get("DIGEST"), "image-contract-differs:digest")
    return image, digest


def check_image_contract(ctx: Context, component: str, sha: str) -> None:
    """build-attest-exact-release-images.yml:1309-1336 in Python."""
    code = "image-contract-differs"
    image, digest = _image_identity(ctx, component)
    inspect = common.load_json(_scan_dir(ctx) / "inspect.json", "image-contract-differs:inspect", canonical=False, decimals=True)
    if type(inspect) is not list or len(inspect) != 1 or type(inspect[0]) is not dict:
        common.fail(code)
    item = inspect[0]
    if item.get("Os") != "linux" or item.get("Architecture") != "amd64":
        common.fail("image-contract-differs:platform")
    repo_digests = item.get("RepoDigests")
    if type(repo_digests) is not list or f"{image}@{digest}" not in repo_digests:
        common.fail("image-contract-differs:repo-digest")
    config = item.get("Config")
    if type(config) is not dict:
        common.fail(code)
    expected = IMAGE_CONTRACT[component]
    ports = config.get("ExposedPorts")
    if (
        config.get("User") != expected["user"]
        or config.get("WorkingDir") != expected["working_dir"]
        or config.get("Entrypoint") != expected["entrypoint"]
        or config.get("Cmd") != expected["cmd"]
        or type(ports) is not dict
        or expected["port"] not in ports
    ):
        common.fail("image-contract-differs:runtime")
    labels = config.get("Labels")
    if type(labels) is not dict or (
        labels.get("org.opencontainers.image.source") != "https://github.com/medtechcorps-netizen/whatomate"
        or labels.get("org.opencontainers.image.revision") != sha
        or labels.get("org.opencontainers.image.version") != f"ship-{sha}"
        or labels.get("org.opencontainers.image.title") != f"rereply-release-{component}"
        or labels.get("io.rereply.release.workflow") != "ship"
    ):
        common.fail("image-contract-differs:labels")


def parse_rfc3339(value: Any, code: str) -> dt.datetime:
    if type(value) is not str:
        common.fail(code)
    match = re.fullmatch(
        r"([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})T([0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})(?:\.[0-9]{1,9})?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})",
        value,
    )
    if match is None:
        common.fail(code)
    zone = "+00:00" if match.group(3) == "Z" else match.group(3)
    try:
        parsed = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(f"{match.group(1)}T{match.group(2)}{zone}")
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise common.ReleaseError(code) from exc
    return parsed.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)


def check_trivy_db(ctx: Context) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The fresh (unpinned) Trivy DB must be at most 48 hours old."""
    code = "image-contract-differs:trivy-db"
    database_dir = ctx.runner_temp() / "trivy-cache" / "db"
    metadata_path = database_dir / "metadata.json"
    database_path = database_dir / "trivy.db"
    for path in (metadata_path, database_path):
        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
            common.fail(code)
    raw = metadata_path.read_bytes()
    if len(raw) > 65536:
        common.fail(code)
    metadata = common.loads_strict(raw, decimals=True, code=code)
    if type(metadata) is not dict:
        common.fail(code)
    updated = parse_rfc3339(metadata.get("UpdatedAt", metadata.get("updatedAt")), code)
    age = (ctx.now() - updated).total_seconds()
    if not TRIVY_DB_MIN_AGE_SECONDS <= age <= TRIVY_DB_MAX_AGE_SECONDS:
        common.fail(code)
    version = ctx.env.get("PINNED_TRIVY_VERSION")
    if type(version) is not str or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", version) is None:
        common.fail(code)
    record = {
        "updated_at": common.format_timestamp(updated.replace(microsecond=0)),
        "metadata_sha256": common.sha256_bytes(raw),
        "version": version,
    }
    target = _scan_dir(ctx) / "trivy-db.json"
    if target.exists() or target.is_symlink():
        common.fail("artifact-invalid:exists")
    target.write_bytes(common.canonical_file_bytes(record))
    return record


def _require_reports(scan: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bytes, bytes, bytes]:
    code = "artifact-invalid:reports"
    sbom_raw = (scan / "sbom.spdx.json").read_bytes() if (scan / "sbom.spdx.json").is_file() else b""
    vuln_raw = (scan / "vulnerability-report.json").read_bytes() if (scan / "vulnerability-report.json").is_file() else b""
    secret_raw = (scan / "secret-report.json").read_bytes() if (scan / "secret-report.json").is_file() else b""
    for name in ("sbom.spdx.json", "vulnerability-report.json", "secret-report.json"):
        if (scan / name).is_symlink():
            common.fail(code)
    if not sbom_raw or not vuln_raw or not secret_raw or len(sbom_raw) > 256 * 1024 * 1024:
        common.fail(code)
    sbom = common.loads_strict(sbom_raw, decimals=True, code=code)
    if (
        type(sbom) is not dict
        or sbom.get("spdxVersion") != "SPDX-2.3"
        or type(sbom.get("documentNamespace")) is not str
        or not sbom["documentNamespace"]
        or type(sbom.get("packages")) is not list
        or not sbom["packages"]
    ):
        common.fail(code)
    vulnerabilities = common.loads_strict(vuln_raw, decimals=True, code=code)
    if type(vulnerabilities) is not dict or type(vulnerabilities.get("Results")) is not list:
        common.fail(code)
    for result in vulnerabilities["Results"]:
        if type(result) is not dict:
            common.fail(code)
        for finding in result.get("Vulnerabilities") or []:
            if type(finding) is not dict or finding.get("Severity") in {"HIGH", "CRITICAL"}:
                common.fail(code)
    secrets = common.loads_strict(secret_raw, decimals=True, code=code)
    if type(secrets) is not dict or type(secrets.get("Results")) is not list:
        common.fail(code)
    for result in secrets["Results"]:
        if type(result) is not dict or result.get("Secrets"):
            common.fail(code)
    return sbom, sbom_raw, vuln_raw, secret_raw


def record_image(ctx: Context, component: str, control: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sha = control["sha"]
    image, digest = _image_identity(ctx, component)
    tag = ctx.env.get("TAG")
    if tag != f"ship-{sha[:12]}-r{control['run_id']}":
        common.fail("image-contract-differs:tag")
    check_image_contract(ctx, component, sha)
    dockerfile_sha256 = check_dockerfile_pins(ctx.repo_dir, component)
    scan = _scan_dir(ctx)
    _sbom, sbom_raw, vuln_raw, secret_raw = _require_reports(scan)
    trivy = common.load_json(scan / "trivy-db.json", "artifact-invalid:trivy-db")
    trivy = common.exact_keys(trivy, {"updated_at", "metadata_sha256", "version"}, "artifact-invalid:trivy-db")
    active_exceptions = trivy_policy.check(ctx.deps.trivy_policy_path, ctx.now().date())
    record = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "component": component,
        "image": image,
        "digest": digest,
        "sha": sha,
        "tag": tag,
        "tag_is_authority": False,
        "dockerfile": DOCKERFILES[component],
        "dockerfile_sha256": dockerfile_sha256,
        "built_at": common.format_timestamp(ctx.now()),
        "sbom_sha256": common.sha256_bytes(sbom_raw),
        "trivy": {
            "version": trivy["version"],
            "db_updated_at": trivy["updated_at"],
            "db_metadata_sha256": trivy["metadata_sha256"],
            "active_exceptions": active_exceptions,
        },
    }
    validate_image_record(record, component, sha)
    output = ctx.runner_temp() / "ship-image"
    if output.exists() or output.is_symlink():
        common.fail("artifact-invalid:exists")
    output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    (output / "image.json").write_bytes(common.canonical_file_bytes(record))
    (output / "sbom.spdx.json").write_bytes(sbom_raw)
    (output / "vulnerability-report.json").write_bytes(vuln_raw)
    (output / "secret-report.json").write_bytes(secret_raw)
    return record


def validate_image_record(value: Any, component: str, sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    code = "artifact-invalid:image-record"
    record = common.exact_keys(
        value,
        {
            "schema_version", "component", "image", "digest", "sha", "tag",
            "tag_is_authority", "dockerfile", "dockerfile_sha256", "built_at",
            "sbom_sha256", "trivy",
        },
        code,
    )
    if (
        record["schema_version"] != 1
        or record["component"] != component
        or record["image"] != common.IMAGE_REPOSITORY[component]
        or record["sha"] != sha
        or record["tag_is_authority"] is not False
        or record["dockerfile"] != DOCKERFILES[component]
    ):
        common.fail(code)
    common.require_digest(record["digest"], code)
    common.exact_string(record["tag"], code, re.compile(r"ship-[0-9a-f]{12}-r[1-9][0-9]{0,14}"))
    if not record["tag"].startswith(f"ship-{sha[:12]}-r"):
        common.fail(code)
    common.require_sha256(record["dockerfile_sha256"], code)
    common.require_timestamp(record["built_at"], code)
    common.require_sha256(record["sbom_sha256"], code)
    trivy = common.exact_keys(record["trivy"], {"version", "db_updated_at", "db_metadata_sha256", "active_exceptions"}, code)
    common.exact_string(trivy["version"], code)
    common.require_timestamp(trivy["db_updated_at"], code)
    common.require_sha256(trivy["db_metadata_sha256"], code)
    common.exact_int(trivy["active_exceptions"], code, 0, trivy_policy.MAX_ENTRIES)
    return record


def cmd_image(ctx: Context, stage: str, component: str) -> int:
    component = _require_component(component)
    control = common.validate_context(ctx.env)
    if stage == "pins":
        dockerfile_sha256 = check_dockerfile_pins(ctx.repo_dir, component)
        ctx.out.text(f"{DOCKERFILES[component]}: pins reviewed (sha256 {dockerfile_sha256})")
    elif stage == "contract":
        check_image_contract(ctx, component, control["sha"])
        ctx.out.text(f"{component}: runtime contract verified")
    elif stage == "trivy-db":
        record = check_trivy_db(ctx)
        ctx.out.text(f"Trivy database updated at {record['updated_at']}")
    elif stage == "record":
        record = record_image(ctx, component, control)
        ctx.out.text(f"{component}: {record['image']}@{record['digest']} recorded")
    else:
        common.fail("input-invalid:stage")
    return EXIT_OK


def cmd_trivy_policy(ctx: Context) -> int:
    common.validate_context(ctx.env)
    count = trivy_policy.check(ctx.deps.trivy_policy_path, ctx.now().date())
    ctx.out.text(f"reviewed Trivy exceptions valid: {count} active")
    return EXIT_OK

def read_image_records(ctx: Context, control: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    code = "artifact-invalid:inventory"
    root = ctx.runner_temp() / "ship-images"
    if root.is_symlink() or not root.is_dir():
        common.fail(code)
    expected = {f"ship-image-{component}-{control['run_id']}": component for component in common.COMPONENTS}
    entries = list(os.scandir(root))
    if {entry.name for entry in entries} != set(expected):
        common.fail(code)
    records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for entry in entries:
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False).st_mode):
            common.fail(code)
        component = expected[entry.name]
        directory = Path(entry.path)
        files = list(os.scandir(directory))
        if {item.name for item in files} != set(IMAGE_FILES):
            common.fail(code)
        for item in files:
            if not stat.S_ISREG(item.stat(follow_symlinks=False).st_mode):
                common.fail(code)
        record = validate_image_record(
            common.load_json(directory / "image.json", "artifact-invalid:image-record"),
            component,
            control["sha"],
        )
        if common.sha256_bytes((directory / "sbom.spdx.json").read_bytes()) != record["sbom_sha256"]:
            common.fail("artifact-invalid:sbom")
        records[component] = record
    digests = [records[component]["digest"] for component in common.COMPONENTS]
    if len(set(digests)) != 3:
        common.fail(code)
    return records


def cmd_candidate(ctx: Context, stage: str) -> int:
    control = common.validate_context(ctx.env)
    records = read_image_records(ctx, control)
    root = ctx.runner_temp() / "ship-images"
    if stage == "read":
        ctx.out.set_outputs(
            {
                "web": records["web"]["digest"],
                "meta_relay": records["meta-relay"]["digest"],
                "gmail_relay": records["gmail-relay"]["digest"],
            }
        )
        ctx.out.text("image records read: 3")
    elif stage == "verify":
        gh = ctx.gh()
        for component in common.COMPONENTS:
            record = records[component]
            suffix = STAGE_SUFFIX[component]
            bundles = []
            for kind in ("PROV", "SBOM"):
                raw = ctx.env.get(f"SHIP_{kind}_BUNDLE_{suffix}")
                if type(raw) is not str or not raw:
                    common.fail("artifact-invalid:bundle")
                path = Path(raw)
                if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
                    common.fail("artifact-invalid:bundle")
                bundles.append(str(path))
            arguments = dict(
                signer_workflow=release_record.SHIP_SIGNER,
                signer_digest=control["workflow_sha"],
                source_digest=control["sha"],
            )
            gh.verify_image(record["image"], record["digest"], predicate_type=release_record.SLSA_PREDICATE,
                            bundle=bundles[0], **arguments)
            sbom_results = gh.verify_image(record["image"], record["digest"],
                                           predicate_type=release_record.SPDX_PREDICATE, bundle=bundles[1], **arguments)
            sbom = common.loads_strict((root / f"ship-image-{component}-{control['run_id']}" / "sbom.spdx.json").read_bytes(),
                                       decimals=True, code="artifact-invalid:sbom")
            if not any(_statement_predicate(item) == sbom for item in sbom_results):
                common.fail("attestation-unverified:sbom")
            gh.verify_image(record["image"], record["digest"], predicate_type=release_record.SLSA_PREDICATE, **arguments)
        ctx.out.text("attestations verified (signer ship.yml, ref main)")
    elif stage == "assemble":
        exceptions = {records[component]["trivy"]["active_exceptions"] for component in common.COMPONENTS}
        if len(exceptions) != 1:
            common.fail("artifact-invalid:trivy")
        candidate = {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "sha": control["sha"],
            "workflow_sha": control["workflow_sha"],
            "built_at": min(records[component]["built_at"] for component in common.COMPONENTS),
            "images": {component: records[component]["digest"] for component in common.COMPONENTS},
            "trivy": {
                "db_updated_at": min(records[component]["trivy"]["db_updated_at"] for component in common.COMPONENTS),
                "active_exceptions": exceptions.pop(),
            },
        }
        validate_candidate(candidate)
        raw = common.canonical_file_bytes(candidate)
        ctx.out.set_outputs(
            {
                "candidate_b64": base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii"),
                "candidate_sha256": common.sha256_bytes(raw),
            }
        )
        ctx.out.summary(
            [
                "## Release candidate",
                "",
                f"- Commit: {candidate['sha']}",
                *_digest_lines(candidate["images"]),
                f"- Trivy database updated at: {candidate['trivy']['db_updated_at']}",
                f"- Active Trivy exceptions: {candidate['trivy']['active_exceptions']}",
                "- attestations verified (signer ship.yml, ref main)",
            ]
        )
        ctx.out.text("candidate assembled")
        if ctx.env.get("SHIP_MODE") == BYPASS_MODE:
            ctx.out.summary(["", *BYPASS_BANNER])
    else:
        common.fail("input-invalid:stage")
    return EXIT_OK


def _statement_predicate(item: Any) -> Any:
    try:
        return item["verificationResult"]["statement"]["predicate"]
    except (KeyError, TypeError):
        return None


def validate_candidate(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    code = "candidate-invalid"
    candidate = common.exact_keys(value, {"schema_version", "sha", "workflow_sha", "built_at", "images", "trivy"}, code)
    if candidate["schema_version"] != 1:
        common.fail(code)
    common.require_sha1(candidate["sha"], code)
    common.require_sha1(candidate["workflow_sha"], code)
    common.require_timestamp(candidate["built_at"], code)
    images = spec_images.require_image_set(candidate["images"], code)
    if len(set(images.values())) != 3:
        common.fail(code)
    trivy = common.exact_keys(candidate["trivy"], {"db_updated_at", "active_exceptions"}, code)
    common.require_timestamp(trivy["db_updated_at"], code)
    common.exact_int(trivy["active_exceptions"], code, 0, trivy_policy.MAX_ENTRIES)
    return candidate


def decode_candidate(env: Mapping[str, str], control: Mapping[str, Any], now: dt.datetime) -> dict[str, Any]:
    code = "candidate-invalid"
    encoded = env.get("CANDIDATE_B64")
    expected = env.get("CANDIDATE_SHA256")
    if type(encoded) is not str or not encoded or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}", encoded) is None:
        common.fail(code)
    try:
        raw = base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise common.ReleaseError(code) from exc
    if common.sha256_bytes(raw) != common.require_sha256(expected, code):
        common.fail(code)
    candidate = validate_candidate(common.loads_strict(raw, code=code))
    if raw != common.canonical_file_bytes(candidate):
        common.fail(code)
    if candidate["sha"] != control["sha"] or candidate["workflow_sha"] != control["workflow_sha"]:
        common.fail("candidate-invalid:foreign-sha")
    age = now - common.require_timestamp(candidate["built_at"], code)
    if age < dt.timedelta(0) or age > CANDIDATE_MAX_AGE:
        common.fail("candidate-stale")
    return candidate
