def parse_target_secret(raw: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
    code = "target-invalid:production-target"
    if type(raw) is not str or not raw or len(raw) > 4096:
        common.fail(code)
    value = common.exact_keys(
        common.loads_strict(raw, code=code), {"schema_version", "app_id", "postgres_cluster_id"}, code
    )
    if value["schema_version"] != 1:
        common.fail(code)
    app_id = common.require_uuid(value["app_id"], code)
    cluster_id = common.require_uuid(value["postgres_cluster_id"], code)
    if app_id == cluster_id:
        common.fail(code)
    return {"app_id": app_id, "postgres_cluster_id": cluster_id}


def production_worst_case_seconds() -> int:
    """Upper bound of one production run that deploys, fails at the end and
    rolls back: the forward path and the rollback path each run one PUT, a
    reconcile, a settle and a full failing smoke. Each poll loop may overrun
    its wall-clock deadline by one sleep plus one iteration of GETs."""
    get = do_app.GET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
    reconcile = do_app.RECONCILE_DEADLINE_SECONDS + do_app.POLL_SECONDS + 2 * get
    settle = do_app.SETTLE_DEADLINE_SECONDS + do_app.POLL_SECONDS + 4 * get
    smoke_seconds = (
        smoke.ROUNDS * len(smoke.HEALTH) * smoke.SOCKET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
        + (smoke.ROUNDS - 1) * smoke.ROUND_DELAY_SECONDS
    )
    forward = do_app.PUT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS + reconcile + settle + smoke_seconds
    rollback = 2 * get + do_app.PUT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS + reconcile + settle + smoke_seconds
    return PREAMBLE_BUDGET_SECONDS + forward + rollback


def _interrupt(signum: int, frame: Any) -> None:
    del signum, frame
    raise KeyboardInterrupt


class _Run:
    """Mutable state of one production run, for exit-code classification."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.put_attempted = False
        self.clients: list[do_app.DOAppClient] = []


def run_production(ctx: Context) -> int:
    # The protected values leave the process environment before anything
    # else runs, so no subprocess can ever inherit them.
    token = ctx.env.pop("SHIP_DO_TOKEN", None)
    target_raw = ctx.env.pop("SHIP_TARGET_JSON", None)
    out = ctx.out
    run = _Run()
    # GitHub stops a cancelled or timed-out job with SIGINT, then SIGTERM;
    # both end in the classified handler below instead of a bare exit.
    installed = threading.current_thread() is threading.main_thread()
    previous_handler: Any = signal.SIG_DFL
    if installed:
        previous_handler = signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _interrupt)
    try:
        return _production(ctx, token if type(token) is str else "", target_raw, run)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        if run.put_attempted:
            safe_text(out, "cancelled after the PUT: the job was interrupted")
            safe_text(out, MANUAL_LINE)
            return EXIT_MANUAL
        safe_text(out, "cancelled before the PUT; production unchanged")
        return EXIT_REFUSED
    except schema_change.SchemaChangeBlocked as exc:
        report_schema_block(out, exc)
        return EXIT_MANUAL if run.put_attempted else EXIT_REFUSED
    except common.ReleaseError as exc:
        if run.put_attempted:
            safe_text(out, f"failed after the PUT: {exc.code}")
            safe_text(out, MANUAL_LINE)
            return EXIT_MANUAL
        safe_text(out, f"refused: {exc.code}; production unchanged")
        return EXIT_REFUSED
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - reported by class-free constant only
        if run.put_attempted:
            safe_text(out, "failed after the PUT: internal-error")
            safe_text(out, MANUAL_LINE)
            return EXIT_MANUAL
        safe_text(out, "refused: internal-error; production unchanged")
        return EXIT_REFUSED
    finally:
        if installed:
            signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, previous_handler if previous_handler is not None else signal.SIG_DFL)
        for client in run.clients:
            client.scrub()
        token = None
        target_raw = None


def _same_state(left: do_app.Snapshot, right: do_app.Snapshot) -> bool:
    return (left.public, left.spec, left.active_id) == (right.public, right.spec, right.active_id)


def _production(ctx: Context, token: str, target_raw: Any, run: _Run) -> int:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + ship_flow.PLAN_SECONDS
    env = ctx.env
    out = ctx.out
    deps = ctx.deps
    # P0 context, ambient credentials and target identity, before any I/O.
    dispatched_mode, target_release = parse_mode(env)
    # Break-glass uses the existing promote path and manifest kind throughout.
    mode = "promote" if dispatched_mode == BYPASS_MODE else dispatched_mode
    if dispatched_mode not in PRODUCTION_MODES:
        common.fail("input-invalid:production-mode")
    control = common.validate_context(env)
    if any(name in env for name in common.FORBIDDEN_AMBIENT) or any(name.startswith("STAGING_") for name in env):
        common.fail("context-invalid:forbidden-ambient-credential")
    if not token:
        common.fail("target-invalid:token")
    out.add_private(token)
    secret = parse_target_secret(target_raw)
    out.add_mask(secret["app_id"])
    out.add_mask(secret["postgres_cluster_id"])
    target = ctx.ship_target()
    if common.sha256_text(secret["app_id"]) != target["app_id_sha256"]:
        common.fail("app-identity-mismatch")
    sha = control["sha"]
    if dispatched_mode == "promote":
        # These are public same-run outputs, never staging provider credentials.
        # Validate them before GitHub or DigitalOcean access in this command.
        import stage_evidence
        stage_evidence.verify(env, control=control, candidate=decode_candidate(env, control, ctx.now()),
            pins=common.load_json(deps.staging_pins_path, "target-invalid:staging-pins"), production=target)
    # P1 inputs.
    if mode == "rollback":
        if target_release != env.get("PLAN_TARGET_RELEASE"):
            common.fail("latest-changed-since-plan:target")
    elif env.get("PLAN_TARGET_RELEASE", "") != "" or env.get("PLAN_TARGET_MANIFEST_SHA256", "") != "":
        common.fail("input-invalid:plan-target")
    gh = ctx.gh()
    # P1a the owner-only approval rule, before any DigitalOcean I/O: the
    # environment still requires the owner's review, and the owner approved
    # this run's production job.
    release_record.require_approval_gate(gh)
    release_record.require_owner_approval(gh, control["run_id"])
    # P2 old-lane quiescence.
    require_old_lanes_idle(gh, ctx.repo_dir)
    # P3 the verified record chain, bound to what the owner approved.
    bootstrap = ctx.bootstrap()
    gate = ship_flow.gate(ctx, control, dispatched_mode, target_release, deadline=deadline)
    chain = gate.resolved.chain
    latest = gate.resolved.latest
    if latest.release != env.get("PLAN_LATEST_RELEASE") or latest.manifest_sha256 != env.get("PLAN_LATEST_MANIFEST_SHA256"):
        common.fail("latest-changed-since-plan")
    # P4 desired images.
    candidate: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    target_entry: ship_flow.record_resolver.ReleaseSelection | None = None
    handoff_outputs = None
    if mode in {"dry-run", "promote"}:
        candidate = decode_candidate(env, control, ctx.now())
        desired_images = dict(candidate["images"])
        if set(desired_images.values()) & set(bootstrap["images"].values()):
            common.fail("candidate-invalid:bootstrap-digest")
        release_record.verify_images(gh, desired_images, sha, bootstrap)
        classification = gate.classification
        # Encoding, size and full decode/replay must succeed before even the
        # first provider read. Oversized evidence cannot strand a deployment.
        handoff_outputs = ship_flow.promotion_outputs(gate, control, desired_images,
            staging="passed" if dispatched_mode == "promote" else "bypassed", private=out.private)
    else:
        target_entry = gate.resolved.selected
        if target_entry.manifest_sha256 != env.get("PLAN_TARGET_MANIFEST_SHA256"):
            common.fail("latest-changed-since-plan:target")
        # The concrete full-chain reader verified every selected image.
        classification = gate.classification
        desired_images = dict(target_entry.images)
        handoff_outputs = ship_flow.rollback_outputs(gate, control, private=out.private)
    for line in (schema_summary(classification) if classification is not None else []) + ship_flow.details(gate):
        safe_text(out, line)
    if gate.qualified_rollback is not None:
        # Custody encoding may consume time. This is a fresh production clock
        # check before provider I/O, never a record-retry qualification clock.
        proof = gate.qualified_rollback
        try:
            observed = ship_flow.ship_rollback_compat._utc(ctx.deps.clock())
        except ship_flow.compat_evidence.CompatRefusal:
            common.fail("candidate-invalid:compat-stale")
        if not proof.checked_at <= observed < proof.artifact_expires_at:
            common.fail("candidate-invalid:compat-stale")
    if gate.outage is not None:
        # Use the original deadline and the full-precision clock after custody
        # encoding. Completion/record retries do not get a new admission clock.
        ship_flow.require_outage_freshness(gate, deadline=deadline, observed_at=ctx.deps.clock())
    # P5 two identical double reads, digest sources, topology and VPC.
    client = do_app.DOAppClient(
        secret["app_id"],
        secret["postgres_cluster_id"],
        token,
        expected_app_id_sha256=target["app_id_sha256"],
        allow_put=mode in PUT_MODES,
        opener=deps.opener,
    )
    run.clients.append(client)
    before = do_app.observe_stable(client)
    _mask_observation(out, client, before)
    spec_images.require_digest_sources(before.spec)
    cluster_name = spec_images.require_topology(before.spec, target)
    out.add_mask(cluster_name)
    origin, host = smoke.canonical_origin(before.ingress, target["default_ingress_sha256"])
    out.add_mask(host)
    out.add_mask(origin)
    live_images = spec_images.extract_image_digests(before.spec)
    # P6 drift.
    if mode in {"dry-run", "promote"}:
        if live_images != dict(latest.images):
            common.fail("drift")
        case = mode
    else:
        assert target_entry is not None
        case = ship_flow.rollback_case(live_images, gate.resolved)
        desired_images = dict(latest.images if case == "restore" else target_entry.images)
    # P7 backup gate (every mode, dry-run included).
    backup = backup_check.check(client, target=target, now=ctx.now())
    out.text(f"backup gate: newest PostgreSQL backup is {backup['age_hours']} h old (limit 36 h)")
    # P9r rollback reconcile: production already runs the target.
    if case == "reconcile":
        assert target_entry is not None
        health = ctx.health(origin)
        again = do_app.observe_stable(client)
        if not _same_state(again, before):
            common.fail("cas-changed")
        out.text(f"reconcile: production already runs {target_entry.release}; no PUT; health {health['health']}")
        _finish(
            ctx,
            kind="rollback",
            sha=target_entry.record_sha,
            images=dict(target_entry.images),
            previous=latest.release,
            rolled_back_from=latest.release,
            built_at="",
            reconciled=True,
            state=before,
            summary=[f"- Outcome: reconcile (no PUT); production runs {target_entry.release}"],
            handoff_outputs=handoff_outputs,
        )
        return EXIT_OK
    # P8 the image-only desired spec and the sanitized digest diff.
    desired_spec = spec_images.set_images(before.spec, desired_images)
    changed = spec_images.require_image_only_change(before.spec, desired_spec)
    if spec_images.environment_value_fingerprint(desired_spec) != before.public["environment_values_sha256"]:
        common.fail("topology-differs:environment")
    if spec_images.non_source_fingerprint(desired_spec) != before.public["non_source_projection_sha256"]:
        common.fail("topology-differs:non-source")
    spec_images.require_topology(desired_spec, target)
    diff_lines = [
        f"- {component}: {live_images[component]} -> {desired_images[component]}"
        + ("" if live_images[component] != desired_images[component] else " (unchanged)")
        for component in common.COMPONENTS
    ]
    out.emit(
        {
            "event": "digest-diff",
            "case": case,
            "components": {
                component: {"current": live_images[component], "desired": desired_images[component]}
                for component in common.COMPONENTS
            },
            "changed_spec_leaves": len(changed),
            "note": "environment/topology fingerprints unchanged, VPC bound",
        }
    )
    out.summary(["## Release production", "", f"- Mode: {mode} ({case})", f"- Commit: {sha}", *diff_lines,
                 f"- Changed spec leaves: {len(changed)}; environment/topology fingerprints unchanged, VPC bound"])
    if dispatched_mode == BYPASS_MODE:
        out.summary(["", *BYPASS_BANNER])
    # P9 dry-run: everything except the PUT.
    if mode == "dry-run":
        health = ctx.health(origin)
        again = do_app.observe_stable(client)
        if not _same_state(again, before):
            common.fail("cas-changed")
        if client.put_count() != 0:
            common.fail("internal-error:dry-run-put")
        out.text(f"dry-run complete: no PUT; current production health {health['health']}")
        out.summary(["- Outcome: dry-run complete, no PUT", ""])
        return EXIT_OK
    # P10 CAS immediately before the one PUT.
    cas = do_app.observe_stable(client)
    if not _same_state(cas, before):
        common.fail("cas-changed")
    # P11 exactly one PUT, never retried.
    run.put_attempted = True
    try:
        client.put_app_once(desired_spec)
    except common.AmbiguousMutation:
        out.text("the PUT outcome is ambiguous; reconciling with GETs only")
    except common.ReleaseError as exc:
        if exc.reason != "provider-rejected":
            raise
        try:
            unchanged = _same_state(do_app.observe_stable(client), before)
        except common.ReleaseError:
            unchanged = False
        if unchanged:
            run.put_attempted = False
            out.text("refused: provider-rejected; production unchanged")
            return EXIT_REFUSED
        out.text("provider-rejected, but production no longer equals the pre-PUT state")
        out.text(MANUAL_LINE)
        return EXIT_MANUAL
    # P12 GET-only reconcile until ACTIVE with PRE_DEPLOY SUCCESS on the web digest.
    rollback = _Rollback(ctx, run, token, secret, target, before, desired_spec, live_images, latest, origin)
    try:
        app_response, deployment_response, ambiguous, candidate_id = do_app.reconcile_until_active(
            client,
            desired_spec,
            job_name=common.PRE_DEPLOY_JOB,
            web_digest=desired_images["web"],
            exclude_ids={before.active_id},
            sleeper=deps.sleeper,
            poll_limit=deps.poll_limit,
        )
    except do_app.TerminalDeployment as exc:
        return rollback.execute("deployment-error", exc.deployment_id)
    except do_app.PostDeployGuard as exc:
        return rollback.execute("post-deploy-guard", getattr(exc, "deployment_id", None))
    except do_app.ReconcileTimeout:
        try:
            unchanged = _same_state(do_app.observe_stable(client), before)
        except common.ReleaseError:
            unchanged = False
        out.text("ambiguous-not-observed: the PUT never became visible" if unchanged else "reconcile-timeout")
        out.text(MANUAL_LINE)
        return EXIT_MANUAL
    out.add_mask(candidate_id)
    # P13 post-deploy guards.
    try:
        after = do_app.provider_snapshot(app_response, deployment_response, client.app_id)
        settled = do_app.observe_settled(client, sleeper=deps.sleeper, poll_limit=deps.poll_limit)
        do_app.require_materially_unchanged(after, settled)
        if spec_images.extract_image_digests(settled.spec) != desired_images:
            raise do_app.PostDeployGuard("post-deploy-guard:images")
        for key in ("environment_values_sha256", "non_source_projection_sha256"):
            if settled.public[key] != before.public[key]:
                raise do_app.PostDeployGuard("post-deploy-guard:fingerprint")
        spec_images.require_topology(settled.spec, target)
        do_app.migration_succeeded(settled.deployment, job_name=common.PRE_DEPLOY_JOB, web_digest=desired_images["web"])
        if client.put_count() != 1 or any(method not in {"GET", "PUT"} for method, _ in client.request_log):
            raise do_app.PostDeployGuard("post-deploy-guard:ledger")
    except common.ReleaseError:
        return rollback.execute("post-deploy-guard", candidate_id)
    # P14 blocking smoke in the same job.
    try:
        health = ctx.health(origin)
    except common.ReleaseError:
        return rollback.execute("smoke-failed", candidate_id)
    # P15 success.
    if case == "promote":
        assert candidate is not None
        kind, record_sha, built_at, rolled_back_from = "promote", sha, candidate["built_at"], ""
    elif case == "rollback":
        assert target_entry is not None
        kind, record_sha, built_at, rolled_back_from = "rollback", target_entry.record_sha, "", latest.release
    else:
        kind, record_sha, built_at, rolled_back_from = "restore", latest.record_sha, "", ""
    out.text(
        f"{kind} complete: health {health['health']}; one PUT"
        + (" (ambiguous, reconciled)" if ambiguous else "")
    )
    _finish(
        ctx,
        kind=kind,
        sha=record_sha,
        images=desired_images,
        previous=latest.release,
        rolled_back_from=rolled_back_from,
        built_at=built_at,
        reconciled=False,
        state=settled,
        summary=[f"- Outcome: {kind} deployed, health {health['health']}, one PUT"],
        handoff_outputs=handoff_outputs,
    )
    return EXIT_OK


def _mask_observation(out: common.Output, client: do_app.DOAppClient, snapshot: do_app.Snapshot) -> None:
    out.add_mask(snapshot.active_id)
    vpc = snapshot.spec.get("vpc")
    if type(vpc) is dict and type(vpc.get("id")) is str:
        out.add_mask(vpc["id"])
    for identity in sorted(client.observed_ids):
        out.add_mask(identity)


def _finish(
    ctx: Context,
    *,
    kind: str,
    sha: str,
    images: Mapping[str, str],
    previous: str,
    rolled_back_from: str,
    built_at: str,
    reconciled: bool,
    state: do_app.Snapshot,
    summary: Sequence[str],
    handoff_outputs: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
) -> None:
    deployed_at = common.format_timestamp(ctx.now())
    release = f"prod-{common.compact_timestamp(deployed_at)}-{sha[:8]}"
    outputs = {
        "release": release,
        "kind": kind,
        "sha": sha,
        "previous": previous,
        "rolled_back_from": rolled_back_from,
        "deployed_at": deployed_at,
        "built_at": built_at,
        "reconciled": "true" if reconciled else "false",
        "environment_values_sha256": state.public["environment_values_sha256"],
        "non_source_projection_sha256": state.public["non_source_projection_sha256"],
    }
    for component in common.COMPONENTS:
        outputs[OUTPUT_DIGEST_KEYS[component]] = images[component]
    if handoff_outputs is not None:
        outputs.update(handoff_outputs)
    ctx.out.set_outputs(outputs)
    ctx.out.summary([*summary, f"- Record to write: {release}", ""])


class _Rollback:
    """AUTO-ROLLBACK: a separate client with its own single-PUT budget,
    re-PUTting the pre-PUT spec only if the live spec still equals what this
    run PUT."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ctx: Context,
        run: _Run,
        token: str,
        secret: Mapping[str, str],
        target: Mapping[str, Any],
        before: do_app.Snapshot,
        desired_spec: Mapping[str, Any],
        live_images: Mapping[str, str],
        latest: ship_flow.record_resolver.ReleaseSelection,
        origin: str,
    ) -> None:
        self.ctx = ctx
        self.run = run
        self._token = token
        self.secret = secret
        self.target = target
        self.before = before
        self.desired_spec = desired_spec
        self.live_images = dict(live_images)
        self.latest = latest
        self.origin = origin

    def _manual(self, reason: str) -> int:
        safe_text(self.ctx.out, f"automatic rollback stopped: {reason}")
        safe_text(self.ctx.out, MANUAL_LINE)
        return EXIT_MANUAL

    def execute(self, reason: str, failed_id: str | None) -> int:
        ctx = self.ctx
        out = ctx.out
        deps = ctx.deps
        out.add_mask(failed_id)
        safe_text(out, f"{reason}: starting the automatic rollback to the pre-PUT spec")
        rollback_client = do_app.DOAppClient(
            self.secret["app_id"],
            self.secret["postgres_cluster_id"],
            self._token,
            expected_app_id_sha256=self.target["app_id_sha256"],
            allow_put=True,
            opener=deps.opener,
        )
        self.run.clients.append(rollback_client)
        if not do_app.observe_for_rollback(rollback_client, self.desired_spec):
            return self._manual("rollback-precondition-failed (the live spec no longer equals what this run PUT)")
        try:
            rollback_client.put_app_once(self.before.spec)
        except common.AmbiguousMutation:
            safe_text(out, "the rollback PUT outcome is ambiguous; reconciling with GETs only")
        except common.ReleaseError:
            return self._manual("rollback-failed:provider-rejected")
        excluded = {self.before.active_id}
        if failed_id:
            excluded.add(failed_id)
        try:
            do_app.reconcile_until_active(
                rollback_client,
                self.before.spec,
                job_name=common.PRE_DEPLOY_JOB,
                web_digest=self.live_images["web"],
                exclude_ids=excluded,
                sleeper=deps.sleeper,
                poll_limit=deps.poll_limit,
            )
            settled = do_app.observe_settled(rollback_client, sleeper=deps.sleeper, poll_limit=deps.poll_limit)
            if spec_images.extract_image_digests(settled.spec) != self.live_images:
                common.fail("rollback-failed:images")
            if rollback_client.put_count() != 1:
                common.fail("rollback-failed:ledger")
        except common.ReleaseError as exc:
            return self._manual(exc.code if exc.reason == "rollback-failed" else "rollback-failed:reconcile")
        try:
            health = ctx.health(self.origin)
        except common.ReleaseError:
            return self._manual("rollback-failed:health")
        restored = (
            self.latest.release if self.live_images == dict(self.latest.images) else "the pre-run state"
        )
        safe_text(out, f"{reason}; rolled back to {restored}; health {health['health']}; no record written")
        try:
            out.summary([f"- Outcome: {reason}; automatically rolled back to {restored}", ""])
        except (common.ReleaseError, OSError):
            pass
        return EXIT_ROLLED_BACK

RECORD_FIELDS = (
    "RELEASE", "KIND", "SHA", "WEB_DIGEST", "META_RELAY_DIGEST", "GMAIL_RELAY_DIGEST",
    "PREVIOUS", "ROLLED_BACK_FROM", "DEPLOYED_AT", "BUILT_AT", "RECONCILED",
    "ENVIRONMENT_VALUES_SHA256", "NON_SOURCE_PROJECTION_SHA256",
)


def _record_fields(env: Mapping[str, str], control: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    code = "record-invalid:inputs"
    raw = {name: env.get(f"REC_{name}", "") for name in RECORD_FIELDS}
    if any(type(value) is not str for value in raw.values()):
        common.fail(code)
    for value in raw.values():
        if value and common.OUTPUT_VALUE_RE.fullmatch(value) is None:
            common.fail(code)
    if raw["RECONCILED"] not in {"true", "false"}:
        common.fail(code)
    fields = {
        "kind": raw["KIND"],
        "release": raw["RELEASE"],
        "sha": raw["SHA"],
        "images": {
            "web": raw["WEB_DIGEST"],
            "meta-relay": raw["META_RELAY_DIGEST"],
            "gmail-relay": raw["GMAIL_RELAY_DIGEST"],
        },
        "previous": raw["PREVIOUS"],
        "rolled_back_from": raw["ROLLED_BACK_FROM"] or None,
        "reconciled": raw["RECONCILED"] == "true",
        "built_at": raw["BUILT_AT"] or None,
        "deployed_at": raw["DEPLOYED_AT"],
        "workflow_sha": control["workflow_sha"],
        "environment_values_sha256": raw["ENVIRONMENT_VALUES_SHA256"],
        "non_source_projection_sha256": raw["NON_SOURCE_PROJECTION_SHA256"],
    }
    try:
        release_record.build_manifest(fields)
    except common.ReleaseError as exc:
        raise common.ReleaseError(code) from exc
    if fields["kind"] == "promote" and fields["sha"] != control["sha"]:
        common.fail(code)
    return fields


def _record_paths(ctx: Context) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    directory = ctx.runner_temp() / "ship-record"
    return directory, directory / release_record.MANIFEST_ASSET


def _find_draft(gh: release_record.Gh, tag: str) -> bool:
    drafts = [
        release for release in gh.releases()
        if type(release) is dict and release.get("tag_name") == tag and release.get("draft") is True
    ]
    if len(drafts) > 1:
        common.fail("record-invalid:duplicate-draft")
    return bool(drafts)


def _record_state(ctx: Context, gh: release_record.Gh, raw: bytes, manifest: Mapping[str, Any],
                  control: Mapping[str, Any], fields: Mapping[str, Any], deadline: float) -> str:
    expected, state = ship_flow.record_bytes(ctx, control, fields, deadline=deadline)
    if expected != raw:
        common.fail("record-invalid:production-differs")
    if state == "published":
        return state
    return "draft" if _find_draft(gh, manifest["release"]) else "new"


def _load_local_manifest(ctx: Context) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, Any], Path]:
    _directory, path = _record_paths(ctx)
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
        common.fail("record-invalid:local")
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    manifest = release_record.validate_manifest(common.loads_strict(raw, code="record-invalid:local"))
    if raw != common.canonical_file_bytes(manifest):
        common.fail("record-invalid:local")
    return raw, manifest, path


def render_notes(manifest: Mapping[str, Any], *, mode: str = "") -> list[str]:
    lines = [
        f"Release record {manifest['release']} ({manifest['kind']}).",
        "",
        "Written by the Release workflow (.github/workflows/ship.yml). The attested asset "
        "release-manifest.json is the record; these notes are informational only.",
        "",
        f"- Commit: {manifest['sha']}",
        *_digest_lines(manifest["images"]),
        f"- Previous record: {manifest['previous']}",
    ]
    if manifest["rolled_back_from"]:
        lines.append(f"- Rolled back from: {manifest['rolled_back_from']}")
    if manifest["reconciled"]:
        lines.append("- Reconciled: production already ran these digests; no PUT")
    if manifest["schema_version"] == 2:
        lines += [f"- Database change: {manifest['db_change']}; dormant: {str(manifest['dormant']).lower()}",
            f"- Catalog: version {manifest['catalog_version']}; minimum reader {manifest['min_reader_version']}",
            f"- Measured catalog SHA256: {manifest['catalog_sha256']}",
            f"- Compatibility: {manifest['compat']}; run: {manifest['compat_run_id'] or 'none'}",
            f"- Reversible: {str(manifest['reversible']).lower()}; old server: {str(manifest['old_server_ok']).lower()}",
            f"- Staging: {manifest['staging']}"]
    if mode == BYPASS_MODE:
        lines += ["", *BYPASS_BANNER]
    return lines


def cmd_record(ctx: Context, stage: str) -> int:
    # All visibility retries in this command share one original source budget.
    deadline = time.monotonic() + ship_flow.SOURCE_SECONDS
    control = common.validate_context(ctx.env, allow_rerun=True)
    out = ctx.out
    gh = ctx.gh()
    if stage == "manifest":
        fields = _record_fields(ctx.env, control)
        raw, state = ship_flow.record_bytes(ctx, control, fields, deadline=deadline)
        manifest = release_record.validate_manifest(common.loads_strict(raw, code="record-invalid"))
        if state != "published":
            state = "draft" if _find_draft(gh, manifest["release"]) else "new"
        directory, path = _record_paths(ctx)
        directory.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
        if path.exists() and path.read_bytes() != raw:
            common.fail("record-invalid:local")
        path.write_bytes(raw)
        out.set_outputs({"tag": manifest["release"], "path": str(path).replace("\\", "/"), "state": state})
        out.text(f"record {manifest['release']}: {state}")
    elif stage == "publish":
        raw, manifest, path = _load_local_manifest(ctx)
        fields = _record_fields(ctx.env, control)
        state = _record_state(ctx, gh, raw, manifest, control, fields, deadline)
        tag = manifest["release"]
        if state == "published":
            out.text(f"record {tag} is already published")
            return EXIT_OK
        notes = path.parent / "notes.md"
        lines = [common.require_public_text(line) for line in render_notes(manifest, mode=ctx.env.get("SHIP_MODE", ""))]
        notes.write_bytes(("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode("ascii"))
        if state == "new":
            gh.run(
                ["release", "create", tag, "--repo", common.REPOSITORY, "--draft", "--target",
                 manifest["sha"], "--title", tag, "--notes-file", str(notes)],
                code="gh-failed:release-create",
            )
            gh.run(["release", "upload", tag, str(path), "--repo", common.REPOSITORY], code="gh-failed:release-upload")
        else:
            gh.run(
                ["release", "upload", tag, str(path), "--repo", common.REPOSITORY, "--clobber"],
                code="gh-failed:release-upload",
            )
        gh.run(["release", "edit", tag, "--repo", common.REPOSITORY, "--draft=false"], code="gh-failed:release-publish")
        out.text(f"record {tag} published")
    elif stage == "verify":
        raw, manifest, path = _load_local_manifest(ctx)
        tag = manifest["release"]
        last_error: common.ReleaseError | None = None
        for attempt in range(6):
            try:
                ship_flow.verify_published(ctx, raw, deadline=deadline)
                last_error = None
                break
            except common.ReleaseError as exc:
                last_error = exc
                if attempt < 5 and time.monotonic() + 10 < deadline:
                    ctx.deps.sleeper(10)
                else:
                    break
        if last_error is not None:
            raise last_error
        out.text(f"record {tag} verified: attested, tag bound to {manifest['sha']}, latest in the chain")
        out.summary(["## Release record", "", *render_notes(manifest, mode=ctx.env.get("SHIP_MODE", "")), ""])
    else:
        common.fail("input-invalid:stage")
    return EXIT_OK


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# entry point
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ship.py",
        description="Release workflow controls (.github/workflows/ship.yml).",
    )
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    commands.add_parser("plan", help="verify CI, records and guards before approval")
    image = commands.add_parser("image", help="images job stages")
    image.add_argument("--stage", required=True, choices=("pins", "contract", "trivy-db", "record"))
    image.add_argument("--component", required=True, choices=common.COMPONENTS)
    commands.add_parser("trivy-policy", help="validate the reviewed expiring exceptions")
    candidate = commands.add_parser("candidate", help="attest job stages")
    candidate.add_argument("--stage", required=True, choices=("read", "verify", "assemble"))
    commands.add_parser("production", help="verify, guard, deploy, smoke and roll back")
    record = commands.add_parser("record", help="record job stages")
    record.add_argument("--stage", required=True, choices=("manifest", "publish", "verify"))
    return parser


def main(
    argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    env: MutableMapping[str, str] | None = None,
    deps: Deps | None = None,
) -> int:
    environment = os.environ if env is None else env
    dependencies = deps or Deps()
    arguments = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    out = common.Output(
        stdout=dependencies.stdout or sys.stdout,
        summary_path=environment.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"),
        output_path=environment.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT"),
    )
    ctx = Context(environment, dependencies, out)
    if arguments.command == "production":
        return run_production(ctx)
    try:
        if arguments.command == "plan":
            return cmd_plan(ctx)
        if arguments.command == "image":
            return cmd_image(ctx, arguments.stage, arguments.component)
        if arguments.command == "trivy-policy":
            return cmd_trivy_policy(ctx)
        if arguments.command == "candidate":
            return cmd_candidate(ctx, arguments.stage)
        if arguments.command == "record":
            return cmd_record(ctx, arguments.stage)
        common.fail("input-invalid:command")
    except schema_change.SchemaChangeBlocked as exc:
        report_schema_block(out, exc)
        return EXIT_REFUSED
    except common.ReleaseError as exc:
        safe_text(out, f"refused: {exc.code}")
        return EXIT_REFUSED
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - never print a traceback or a value
        safe_text(out, "refused: internal-error")
        return EXIT_REFUSED


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Concrete normal preflight; no provider mutation or transferable authority.

The public operation constructs its own release and Actions adapters. The ship
caller runs it afresh at plan, staging and production admission. Conditional
owner collection shares each original source budget and final rechecks; the
final complete observation is preserved separately from immutable source facts.
Active-contract semantic qualification remains refused. Returned projections do
not promise future freshness. No rollback or break-glass path exists here.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import math
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import threading
import time

import compat_collect as collect
import compat_evidence as evidence
import compat_request as bridge
import record_resolver as resolver
import record_transport as transport
import forward_gates
import contract_authorization as contract

common, runtime = transport.common, transport.runtime
MAX_SECONDS = 2400
MAX_COMMANDS = 6000
MAX_BYTES = 128 * 1024 * 1024
CLEANUP_RESERVE = 2.25
_DIAGNOSTIC_PHASES = frozenset(("input", "source-before", "actions", "source-after", "qualification"))
_DIAGNOSTIC_CATEGORIES = frozenset(("deadline", "capture", "command-nonzero", "signature", "bound", "other"))


def _need(value, detail):
    if not value:
        raise evidence.CompatRefusal("compat-stale", "preflight-" + detail)


def _finite(value):
    return type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value)


def _regular(path, *, directory=False):
    _need(isinstance(path, Path) and path.is_absolute() and path.resolve() == path, "path")
    _need(not any(part.is_symlink() or getattr(part, "is_junction", lambda: False)()
                  for part in (path, *path.parents)), "path")
    _need(all(part.is_dir() for part in path.parents), "path")
    _need(path.is_dir() if directory else path.is_file(), "path")
    stat = path.stat()
    return stat.st_dev, stat.st_ino


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NormalPreflight:
    resolution: resolver.ForwardResolution = field(repr=False)
    qualified: evidence.QualifiedCompat
    collected: collect.CollectedHistory = field(repr=False)
    command_count: int
    captured_bytes: int
    drills: forward_gates.DrillGate | None = None
    contract_observation: contract.ContractObservation | None = None


class _Budget:
    """An aggregate allowance, not a replacement for either transport grammar."""
    def __init__(self, deadline, *, capture, clock):
        now = clock()
        _need(_finite(now) and _finite(deadline) and now < deadline, "deadline")
        self.end, self._last = min(deadline, now + MAX_SECONDS), now
        self._started = now
        self._phase = "input"
        self._failure_category = self._failure_phase = None
        self.clock, self._capture = clock, capture
        self.commands = self.captured_bytes = 0
        self.failed = self.closed = False
        self._paths = ()
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def note_failure(self, category, phase=None):
        # Never serialize arbitrary exception text, arguments or capture data.
        if self._failure_category is None:
            self._failure_category = category if category in _DIAGNOSTIC_CATEGORIES else "other"
            self._failure_phase = phase if phase in _DIAGNOSTIC_PHASES else self._phase

    def report_refusal(self):
        # This is only a lower bound from the existing monotonic samples. No
        # new clock/read, policy result, transferable evidence or authority.
        phase = self._phase if self._phase in _DIAGNOSTIC_PHASES else "input"
        category = self._failure_category if self._failure_category in _DIAGNOSTIC_CATEGORIES else "other"
        first = self._failure_phase if self._failure_phase in _DIAGNOSTIC_PHASES else phase
        elapsed = max(0, int((self._last - self._started) * 1000))
        try:
            print(f"verification-refused phase={phase} first_failure_phase={first} "
                  f"first_failure_category={category} sampled_elapsed_ms_lower_bound={elapsed} "
                  f"commands={self.commands} captured_bytes={self.captured_bytes}", file=sys.stderr)
        except Exception:
            pass  # A diagnostic output failure must not replace the refusal.

    def fail(self, detail):
        self.note_failure({"deadline": "deadline", "capture": "capture",
                           "capture-input": "capture", "bound": "bound"}.get(detail, "other"))
        self.failed = True
        raise evidence.CompatRefusal("compat-stale", "preflight-" + detail) from None

    def remaining(self):
        if self.failed or self.closed:
            self.fail("closed")
        now = self.clock()
        if not _finite(now) or not self._last <= now < self.end:
            self.fail("deadline")
        self._last = now
        return self.end - now

    def bind(self, root, gh, git):
        self._paths = tuple((path, directory, _regular(path, directory=directory))
                            for path, directory in ((root, True), (gh, False), (git, False)))

    def check(self):
        self.remaining()
        for path, directory, identity in self._paths:
            _need(_regular(path, directory=directory) == identity, "path-changed")

    def close(self):
        if self.closed:
            return
        try:
            if not self.failed:
                self.check()
        finally:
            self.closed = True

    def capture(self, argv, *, env, timeout, stdout_limit, stderr_limit):
        self.check()
        _need(type(argv) is list and argv and type(argv[0]) is str
              and argv[0] in {str(row[0]) for row in self._paths[1:]}, "command")
        _need(_finite(timeout) and timeout > 0
              and all(type(limit) is int and 0 <= limit <= 64 * 1024 * 1024
                      for limit in (stdout_limit, stderr_limit)), "capture-input")
        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            self.fail("concurrent")
        try:
            allowance = MAX_BYTES - self.captured_bytes
            if self.commands >= MAX_COMMANDS or allowance <= stderr_limit:
                self.fail("bound")
            duration = min(timeout, self.remaining() - CLEANUP_RESERVE)
            if duration <= 0:
                self.fail("deadline")
            limit = min(stdout_limit, allowance - stderr_limit)
            self.commands += 1
            try:
                result = self._capture(argv, env=env, timeout=duration,
                                       stdout_limit=limit, stderr_limit=stderr_limit)
            except Exception:
                self.fail("capture")
            if (type(result) is not runtime.Capture or type(result.returncode) is not int
                    or type(result.stdout) is not bytes or type(result.stderr) is not bytes
                    or len(result.stdout) > limit or len(result.stderr) > stderr_limit):
                self.fail("capture")
            self.captured_bytes += len(result.stdout) + len(result.stderr)
            if self._phase == "actions" and result.returncode != 0:
                self.note_failure("command-nonzero")
            self.check()
            return result
        finally:
            self._lock.release()


def _scratch(path, repo):
    _need(isinstance(path, Path) and path.is_absolute() and path.resolve() == path, "scratch")
    _regular(path.parent, directory=True)
    _need(not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink()
          and not getattr(path, "is_junction", lambda: False)()
          and not path.is_relative_to(repo) and not repo.is_relative_to(path), "scratch")
    path.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    _regular(path, directory=True)
    for phase in ("source-before", "actions", "source-after"):
        parent = path / phase
        parent.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        for child in ("config", "work"):
            (parent / child).mkdir(mode=0o700)


def _source(budget, repo, sha, gh, git, token, phase, env):
    budget.check()
    operation = transport.OperationBudget(budget.end, profile="normal-admission", capture=budget.capture, clock=budget.clock)
    try:
        client = transport.ReleaseGh(gh, token, phase / "config", phase / "work",
                                     budget=operation, base_env=env)
        return resolver.resolve_admission_forward(client, repo, git, sha)
    except Exception:
        budget.note_failure(operation._failure_category)
        # close must not mask the primary source refusal on construction errors.
        operation.failed = True
        raise
    finally:
        operation.close()


def _contract_pair(before, after, history_observed_at):
    """Compare all observed facts; only the collection instant may advance."""
    _need(type(before) is resolver.ForwardAdmission and type(after) is resolver.ForwardAdmission,
          "admission")
    _need(before.resolution == after.resolution, "source-changed")
    forward_gates.validate_preserved_contract(before.resolution, before.contract_observation)
    forward_gates.validate_preserved_contract(after.resolution, after.contract_observation)
    first, last = before.contract_observation, after.contract_observation
    if first is None:
        _need(last is None, "contract-changed")
        return None
    _need(type(last) is contract.ContractObservation
          and replace(first, observed_at=last.observed_at) == last, "contract-changed")
    _need(type(history_observed_at) is datetime and history_observed_at.tzinfo is timezone.utc
          and history_observed_at.fold == 0
          and first.observed_at <= last.observed_at
          and history_observed_at <= last.observed_at, "contract-clock")
    return last


def _preflight(repo_dir, candidate_sha, *, gh_binary, git_binary, token, scratch_dir,
               deadline, capture, clock, wall_clock, base_env):
    """Private test seams control commands/time, never supplied evidence facts."""
    budget = _Budget(deadline, capture=capture, clock=clock)
    client = None
    try:
        _need(type(candidate_sha) is str and common.SHA1_RE.fullmatch(candidate_sha), "source")
        _need(type(token) is str and 0 < len(token) <= 8192
              and not any(char in token for char in "\r\n\0"), "token")
        _regular(repo_dir, directory=True)
        _regular(gh_binary)
        _regular(git_binary)
        _scratch(scratch_dir, repo_dir)
        budget.bind(scratch_dir, gh_binary, git_binary)
        env = common.scrubbed_env(base=base_env)
        budget._phase = "source-before"
        before = _source(budget, repo_dir, candidate_sha, gh_binary, git_binary, token,
                         scratch_dir / "source-before", env)
        budget.check()
        _need(before.resolution.resolved.inventory.main_sha == candidate_sha, "main-changed")
        budget._phase = "actions"
        phase = scratch_dir / "actions"
        client = collect.ActionsGh(str(gh_binary), token, phase / "config",
            seconds=min(600, budget.remaining()), base_env=env, capture=budget.capture, clock=budget.clock)
        history = collect.collect_history(collect.CollectionRequest(candidate_sha, before.resolution.workflow),
                                           client, phase / "work", wall_clock=wall_clock)
        budget.check()
        if client._failure_category is not None:
            budget.note_failure(client._failure_category, "actions")
        budget._phase = "source-after"
        after = _source(budget, repo_dir, candidate_sha, gh_binary, git_binary, token,
                        scratch_dir / "source-after", env)
        budget.check()
        budget._phase = "qualification"
        observation = _contract_pair(before, after, history.history.observed_at)
        qualified = bridge.qualify(after.resolution, history)
        budget.check()
        observed_at = wall_clock()
        _need(type(observed_at) is datetime and observed_at.tzinfo is timezone.utc
              and observed_at.fold == 0 and observed_at >= history.history.observed_at, "drill-clock")
        _need(observation is None or observed_at >= observation.observed_at, "contract-clock")
        drills = forward_gates.observe_forward_drills(after.resolution, now=observed_at)
        budget.check()
        return NormalPreflight(after.resolution, qualified, history, budget.commands, budget.captured_bytes,
                               drills, observation)
    except (forward_gates.DrillRefusal, contract.ContractRefusal) as exc:
        budget.failed = True
        common.fail("schema-change-blocked:" + str(exc))
    except (evidence.CompatRefusal, common.ReleaseError):
        budget.failed = True
        raise
    except Exception:
        budget.fail("invalid")
    finally:
        if budget.failed and client is not None and client._failure_category is not None:
            budget.note_failure(client._failure_category, "actions")
        try:
            budget.close()
        finally:
            if budget.failed:
                budget.report_refusal()


def preflight(repo_dir: Path, candidate_sha: str, *, gh_binary: Path, git_binary: Path,
              token: str, scratch_dir: Path, deadline: float) -> NormalPreflight:
    """Resolve, collect, re-resolve and qualify under one caller-owned deadline.

    deadline is an absolute time.monotonic value created by the caller before
    invoking this function. The operation caps itself at 2400 seconds and never
    fetches Git history. scratch_dir must be a fresh private location outside
    the repository; failed/successful evidence is retained, never replayed.
    No caller-supplied clients, source facts or proof receipts are accepted.
    """
    return _preflight(repo_dir, candidate_sha, gh_binary=gh_binary, git_binary=git_binary,
        token=token, scratch_dir=scratch_dir, deadline=deadline,
        capture=runtime.bounded_command, clock=time.monotonic,
        wall_clock=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc), base_env=os.environ)
after.release/deployment/ship_flow.py:
"""Source and record integration for the protected Release workflow.

The public read adapters establish authority. These helpers do not accept an
external receipt in place of a fresh read. Promotion inputs cross jobs only
through the successful production job's fixed needs outputs in ship.yml.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from functools import wraps
import math
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import time
import uuid

import compat_evidence
import compat_negative_index
import record_handoff
import record_resolver
import record_writer
import forward_gates
import contract_authorization
import ship_compat
import ship_outage_compat
import ship_rollback_compat
import ship_records
import ship_common as common

records = record_resolver.records
policy = record_resolver.policy
SOURCE_SECONDS = 600
PLAN_SECONDS = 2400


def _need(value, code):
    if not value:
        common.fail(code)


def _fixed(function):
    @wraps(function)
    def call(*args, **kwargs):
        try:
            return function(*args, **kwargs)
        except compat_evidence.CompatRefusal as exc:
            code = exc.code if exc.code in ('compat-missing', 'compat-old-server-incompatible',
                'irreversible-needs-fix-forward-mode') else 'compat-stale'
            common.fail('candidate-invalid:' + code)
        except compat_negative_index.NegativeIndexRefusal:
            common.fail('candidate-invalid:compat-stale')
        except policy.PolicyRefusal:
            common.fail('record-chain-invalid:policy')
        except forward_gates.DrillRefusal as exc:
            common.fail('schema-change-blocked:' + str(exc))
        except contract_authorization.ContractRefusal as exc:
            common.fail('schema-change-blocked:' + str(exc))
        except record_writer.WriterRefusal:
            common.fail('record-invalid:writer')
        except record_handoff.HandoffRefusal:
            common.fail('record-invalid:handoff')
    return call


def _options(ctx, deadline):
    _need(type(deadline) in (int, float) and time.monotonic() < deadline, 'record-chain-invalid:source-deadline')
    binary = shutil.which('git', path=ctx.env.get('PATH'))
    _need(binary is not None, 'record-chain-invalid:git-unavailable')
    return dict(gh_binary=Path(ctx.env.get('SHIP_GH_BIN', '')),
        git_binary=Path(binary).absolute(), token=ctx.env.get('GH_TOKEN', ''),
        scratch_dir=ctx.work_dir('source-reads') / uuid.uuid4().hex, deadline=deadline)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Gate:
    resolved: record_resolver.ResolvedChain
    normal: ship_compat.NormalPreflight | None
    rollback: record_resolver.RollbackResolution | None
    qualified_rollback: ship_rollback_compat.RollbackPreflight | None = None
    outage: ship_outage_compat.OutagePreflight | None = None

    @property
    def classification(self):
        if self.normal is not None:
            return self.normal.resolution.classification
        if self.outage is not None:
            return self.outage.source.admission.resolution.classification
        if self.qualified_rollback is not None:
            return None
        return self.rollback.legacy_classification


def _complete_source(resolution, sha):
    sources = tuple(source for source in resolution.resolved.chain.sources if source.sha == sha)
    if len(sources) != 1 or sources[0].mode != 'reviewed-v0':
        return None
    source = sources[0]
    if tuple(path for path, _digest in source.artifacts) != policy.SOURCE_PATHS:
        return None
    return source


def _staging_bypass(result):
    # This is staging bypass with successful normal compat, NOT compat-outage
    # bypass. Use only the internally authenticated preflight projection.
    resolution = result.resolution
    change = resolution.classification
    _need(change.kind == 'none' and not change.dormant and not change.reasons
          and not change.migration_changes, 'schema-change-blocked:staging-bypass')
    # The migration-path check is against the retained database origin. Until
    # this projection carries that check against the latest source as well,
    # refuse their divergence even when all seven artifact hashes are equal.
    _need(resolution.database_base_source == resolution.resolved.latest.record_sha,
          'schema-change-blocked:staging-bypass-source-diverged')
    # Legacy reader0 proves no artifact bytes, so absence is not equality.
    for sha in {resolution.resolved.latest.record_sha, resolution.database_base_source}:
        source = _complete_source(resolution, sha)
        _need(source is not None, 'schema-change-blocked:staging-bypass-source-unavailable')
        _need(source.artifacts == resolution.candidate.artifacts,
              'schema-change-blocked:staging-bypass-artifacts')


@_fixed
def gate(ctx, control, mode, target, *, deadline):
    options = _options(ctx, deadline)
    if mode == 'rollback':
        result = ship_rollback_compat.admit(ctx.repo_dir, control['sha'], target, **options)
        if type(result) is ship_rollback_compat.RollbackPreflight:
            return Gate(result.resolution.resolved, None, None, result)
        _need(type(result) is record_resolver.RollbackResolution, 'record-chain-invalid:policy')
        return Gate(result.resolved, None, result)
    _need(mode in ('dry-run', 'promote', 'stage', 'promote-without-staging'), 'input-invalid:mode')
    if mode == 'promote-without-staging':
        result = ship_outage_compat.preflight(ctx.repo_dir, control['sha'], **options)
        if type(result) is ship_outage_compat.OutagePreflight:
            return Gate(result.source.admission.resolution.resolved, None, None, outage=result)
        _need(type(result) is ship_compat.NormalPreflight, 'candidate-invalid:compat-stale')
        _staging_bypass(result)
    else:
        result = ship_compat.preflight(ctx.repo_dir, control['sha'], **options)
    return Gate(result.resolution.resolved, result, None)


@_fixed
def _forward_paths(resolution):
    """Render the complete checked projection; never discover source here."""
    if type(resolution) is not record_resolver.ForwardResolution:
        raise policy.PolicyRefusal('record-source-invalid')
    if resolution.audit is None:
        return ['- Other changed source paths: unavailable (historical source audit absent)']
    audit = record_resolver.validate_forward_audit(resolution.audit,
        candidate_sha=resolution.candidate.sha, database_base_source=resolution.database_base_source,
        latest_record_sha=resolution.resolved.latest.record_sha,
        selected_web_source_sha=resolution.resolved.selected.actual_web_source_sha)
    lines = []
    for change in audit.changes:
        lines.append(f'- Changed source range ({", ".join(change.roles)}): '
            f'{change.base_sha} -> {change.head_sha}; paths: {len(change.rows)}')
        lines.extend(f'  - {row.status} {row.path}' for row in change.rows)
    # Row text is shorter than its canonical representation; reserve a small
    # fixed margin for the at-most-three headers. Never omit a path to fit.
    _need(sum(len(line) + 1 for line in lines) <= record_resolver.MAX_AUDIT_BYTES + 2048,
          'output-unsafe:text')
    return [common.require_public_text(line) for line in lines]


@_fixed
def _drill_details(normal):
    if normal.drills is None:
        return ['- Restore drills: unobserved (historical custody)']
    observation = forward_gates.validate_preserved_drills(normal.resolution, normal.drills)
    observed = observation.observed_at.isoformat().replace('+00:00', 'Z')
    if not observation.required:
        return [f'- Restore drills: not required for none or dormant changes; observed at {observed}']
    return [f'- Restore drills: current at original observation {observed}; '
        f'staging restore {observation.staging_restore.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")}; '
        f'production fork {observation.production_fork.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")}']


@_fixed
def _contract_details(normal):
    receipt = forward_gates.validate_preserved_contract(normal.resolution, normal.contract_observation)
    if receipt is None:
        return ['- Contract owner label: not required for this change']
    observed = receipt.observed_at.isoformat().replace('+00:00', 'Z')
    return [f'- Contract owner label: observed at {observed}; PR {receipt.pull_number}; '
            f'event {receipt.event_node_id} (original observation; no DDL authority)']


def details(value):
    """Public summary values derived from the already checked gate."""
    latest = value.resolved.latest

    """Check retained selected metadata without inventing a later observation."""
    source = next(row for row in collected.history.workflows
                  if row.sha == qualified.binding.producer_sha)
    matches = []
    for row in collected.history.attempts:
        run = common.loads_strict(row.envelope.raw)['run']
        if (run['id'], run['run_attempt']) == (qualified.run_id, qualified.run_attempt):
            matches.append(row)

                              observed_at=collected.history.observed_at)

    _need(len(artifacts) == 1 and artifacts[0].expired is False
          and checked_at < artifacts[0].expires, 'artifact-expired')

    """Pure original-time replay for closed custody, never a fresh permission.

    The codec/writer must bind the original protected workflow execution and
    exact parent independently. No caller-provided verdict, retry clock or
    deserialized type establishes source or signature provenance.
    """
    try:

              'preserved-type')

              and type(value.captured_bytes) is int and 0 < value.captured_bytes <= normal.MAX_BYTES,
              'preserved-bounds')

        _need(value.qualified == qualified, 'preserved-qualification')
        _need(_utc(value.entry_at) <= value.collected.history.observed_at <= _utc(value.checked_at)
              and value.command_count >= value.collected.command_count
              and value.captured_bytes >= value.collected.captured_bytes, 'preserved-clock')

PUBLISHER_NAMESPACE_RECORDS = 1024

    return all(part.casefold() not in {"", ".", "..", ".git"} for part in parts)

    retained for consistency with the separately pinned executable bytes.
    Well-framed unsupported topology never becomes a normal-proof veto.

    if not raw:

    _need(raw.endswith(b"\0"), "namespace-frame")
    records = raw[:-1].split(b"\0")
    _need(len(records) <= PUBLISHER_NAMESPACE_RECORDS and all(records), "namespace-bound")
    rows, seen, folded = [], {}, set()
    eligible = True
    for record in records:

              and all(32 <= ord(char) <= 126 and char != "\\" for char in path)
              and all(part.casefold() not in (".", "..", ".git") for part in parts)
              and not path.startswith("/") and path not in seen
              and path.casefold() not in folded, "namespace-path")
        _need(path == "release" or any(path == root or path.startswith(root + "/")
              for root in _PUBLISHER_PATHS), "namespace-scope")
        parent = path.rpartition("/")[0]
        _need(not parent or parent in seen and seen[parent][1:3] == ("040000", "tree"),
              "namespace-parent")
        row = (path, mode, kind, oid)

class ControlledWorld(transport_tests.World):
    def __init__(self, repo, binary, clock):
        super().__init__()
        self.repo, self.binary, self.clock = repo, binary, clock
        self.commits, self.files, self.blobs = set(), {}, {}
        self.bad_ancestor = False
        self.bad_pairs = set()
        self.history = {}
        self.before = self.after = None
        self.trace = []

    def __call__(self, argv, **options):
        argv = list(argv)
        self.trace.append((argv, dict(options)))
        if self.before:
            self.before(argv)
        if argv[0] == str(self.binary):
            # Fixed source_git prefix ends at this advice setting. No shell or
            # executable is launched, and all remaining commands are explicit.
            args = argv[argv.index("advice.graftFileDeprecated=false") + 1:]
            result = self.git(args)
        else:
            result = super().__call__(argv, **options)
        if self.after:
            self.after(argv)
        return result

    def git(self, args):
        data, code = b"", 0
        if args == ["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"]:
            data = (str(self.repo) + "\n").encode()
        elif args == ["rev-parse", "--show-object-format"]:
            data = b"sha1\n"
        elif args == ["rev-parse", "--is-shallow-repository"]:
            data = b"false\n"
        elif args == ["for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)", "refs/replace/"]:
            pass
        elif args[:2] == ["config", "--get-regexp"]:
            code = 1
        elif args[0] == "rev-parse" and args[1] in ("--absolute-git-dir", "--git-common-dir"):
            data = (str(self.repo / ".git") + "\n").encode()
        elif args[:2] == ["cat-file", "-t"]:
            data = b"commit\n" if args[2] in self.commits else b"blob\n"
        elif args[:2] == ["ls-tree", "-z"]:
            raw = self.files.get((args[2], args[4]))
            if raw is not None:
                oid = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
                self.blobs[oid] = raw
                data = f"100644 blob {oid}\t{args[4]}\0".encode()
        elif args[:2] == ["cat-file", "-s"]:
            data = str(len(self.blobs[args[2]])).encode() + b"\n"
        elif args[:2] == ["cat-file", "blob"]:
            data = self.blobs[args[2]]
        elif args[0] == "merge-base":
            data = (("f" * 40 if self.bad_ancestor or tuple(args[1:]) in self.bad_pairs else args[1]) + "\n").encode()
        elif args[:3] == ["rev-list", "--first-parent", "--reverse"]:
            base, head = args[3].split("..")
            revisions = self.history.get((base, head), [] if base == head else [head])
            data = b"".join((revision + "\n").encode() for revision in revisions)
        elif args[:4] == ["ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "-z"]:
            data = b"".join(path.encode() + b"\0" for revision, path in sorted(self.files)
                            if revision == args[4] and any(path == prefix.rstrip("/")
                                or path.startswith(prefix.rstrip("/") + "/") for prefix in args[6:]))
        elif args[0] == "diff" and "--name-status" in args:
            base, head = args[-3:-1]
            paths = sorted({path for revision, path in self.files if revision in (base, head)})
            for path in paths:
                before, after = self.files.get((base, path)), self.files.get((head, path))
                if before != after:
                    status = "A" if before is None else "D" if after is None else "M"
                    data += (status + "\0" + path + "\0").encode()
        elif args[0] == "diff" and "-U0" in args:
            base, head, _, path = args[-4:]
            before = self.files.get((base, path), b"").decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
            after = self.files.get((head, path), b"").decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
            data = "".join(difflib.unified_diff(before, after, fromfile="a/" + path,
                                             tofile="b/" + path, n=0)).encode()
        else:
            raise AssertionError("unmodeled synthetic Git command")
        return rt.runtime.Capture(code, data, b"")


class ResolverTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.source_bytes = {path: (ROOT / path).read_bytes() for path in policy.SOURCE_PATHS}
        cls.v0 = policy.reviewed_v0_source("1" * 40,

    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.repo = self.root / "repo"
        (self.repo / ".git").mkdir(parents=True)
        self.git = self.root / "git.exe"
        self.gh = self.root / "gh.exe"
        self.git.write_bytes(b"not executable")
        self.gh.write_bytes(b"not executable")
        self.clock = transport_tests.Clock()
        self.world = ControlledWorld(self.repo, self.git, self.clock)
        self.boot = records.load_bootstrap()
        self.documents = [self.boot]
        self.world.commits.add(self.boot["sha"])
        self.world.fake.attest_legacy_images(self.boot["images"], self.boot["sha"],
            workflow_sha=self.boot["legacy_signer"]["workflow_sha"])
        self.client = None

    def add(self, *, version=2, sha=None, kind="promote", target=None, images=None, **changes):
        prior = self.documents[-1]
        sha = sha or str(len(self.documents)) * 40
        if target:
            sha, images = target["sha"], target["images"]
        if kind == "restore":
            sha, images = prior["sha"], prior["images"]
        images = images or {key: "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256((sha + key).encode()).hexdigest()
                            for key in common.COMPONENTS}
        doc = support.manifest(kind=kind, sha=sha, images=images, previous=prior["release"],
            deployed_at=f"2026-10-04T12:{len(self.documents):02d}:00Z",
            rolled_back_from=prior["release"] if kind == "rollback" else None)
        if version == 2:
            doc.update(schema_version=2, db_change="none", dormant=False, reversible=True,
                old_server_ok=True, compat_run_id=38100000001, compat="ok", staging="passed",
                fixed_forward_from=None, **self.v0.catalog._asdict())
            if kind != "promote":
                doc.update(old_server_ok="unproven", compat_run_id=None, compat="bypassed", staging="bypassed")
        doc.update(changes)
        self.documents.append(doc)
        self.world.add(doc)
        self.world.fake.attest_ship_images(images, sha)
        self.world.commits.add(sha)
        if version == 2:
            self.world.files.update({(sha, path): raw for path, raw in self.source_bytes.items()})
        return doc

    def resolve(self, tag=None):
        self.assertIsNone(self.client, "each synthetic operation must be fresh")
        config, work = self.root / "config", self.root / "work"
        config.mkdir(); work.mkdir()
        budget = rt.OperationBudget(700, capture=self.world, clock=self.clock)
        self.client = rt.ReleaseGh(self.gh, support.GH_TOKEN, config, work, budget=budget,
                                  base_env={"SHIP_DO_TOKEN": "private-do-token"})
        return resolver.resolve_authenticated(self.client, self.repo, self.git, tag)

    def refused(self, tag=None):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(rt.TransportRefusal, "record-chain-invalid:transport-resolver$") as caught:
            self.resolve(tag)
        self.assertNotIn("private", str(caught.exception))
        self.assertTrue(self.client.budget.closed)

class ForwardResolverTests(unittest.TestCase):
    # Reuse only scenario setup; the original 35 test methods remain singly
    # discovered and unchanged. No classifier or authentication call is mocked.
    setUpClass = ResolverTests.__dict__["setUpClass"]
    setUp = ResolverTests.setUp
    add = ResolverTests.add
    WORKFLOW = ".github/workflows/compat.yml"
    MAIN = "cmd/whatomate/main.go"
    RECIPE = "docker/release/web.Dockerfile"

    def profile(self, sha, *, closure="a" * 64, body=1):
        self.world.commits.add(sha)
        files = dict(self.source_bytes)
        files[self.WORKFLOW] = (ROOT / self.WORKFLOW).read_bytes()
        files[self.RECIPE] = b"FROM scratch\n# immutable synthetic recipe\n"
        files[resolver._DRILLS] = (ROOT / resolver._DRILLS).read_bytes()
        files[self.MAIN] = f"package main\n\nfunc runRLSMigration(args []string) {{\n\tprintln({body})\n}}\n".encode()
        files[schema_change.MIGRATION_PATH] = common.canonical_file_bytes({
            "version": 1, "roots": schema_change.MIGRATION_ROOTS,
            "closure_files": [self.MAIN], "closure_sha256": closure})
        self.world.files.update({(sha, path): raw for path, raw in files.items()})
        return sha

    def candidate(self, sha="7" * 40, **kwargs):
        return self.profile(sha, **kwargs)

    def forward(self, sha, *, selected_tag=None):
        self.assertIsNone(self.client)
        config, work = self.root / "config", self.root / "work"
        config.mkdir(); work.mkdir()
        budget = rt.OperationBudget(700, capture=self.world, clock=self.clock)
        self.client = rt.ReleaseGh(self.gh, support.GH_TOKEN, config, work, budget=budget,
                                  base_env={"SHIP_DO_TOKEN": "private-do-token"})
        return resolver.resolve_forward(self.client, self.repo, self.git, sha, selected_tag=selected_tag)

    def refused(self, sha, *, selected_tag=None):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(rt.TransportRefusal, "record-chain-invalid:transport-resolver$"):
            self.forward(sha, selected_tag=selected_tag)
        self.assertTrue(self.client.budget.closed)
        self.assertTrue(self.client.budget.failed)
        self.assertIsNone(records._GIT_OUTPUT_TRANSPORT.get())

        old = self.add()

        self.assertEqual((result.candidate.sha, result.candidate.mode), (sha, "reviewed-v0"))
        self.assertEqual((result.classification.kind, result.classification.dormant, result.classification.reasons),
                         ("none", False, ()))
        self.assertEqual(result.classification.requirements, ("compat-required", "generated-migration-closure-ci"))
        self.assertEqual(result.workflow, (ROOT / self.WORKFLOW).read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(result.workflow_sha256, hashlib.sha256(result.workflow).hexdigest())
        self.assertEqual(result.previous_web_source_sha, old["sha"])
        self.assertEqual(result.database_base_source, old["sha"])
        self.assertTrue(self.client.budget.closed)
        self.assertIsNone(records._GIT_OUTPUT_TRANSPORT.get())

    def ordinary(self):
        old = self.add()
        self.profile(old["sha"])
        return old["sha"], self.candidate()

    def audit_output(self, raw):
        original = self.world.git
        active = False
        def response(args):
            nonlocal active
            if args[:2] == ["ls-tree", "-z"] and args[-1] == resolver._DRILLS:
                active = True
            if active and args[0] == "diff" and "--name-status" in args:
                return rt.runtime.Capture(0, raw, b"")
            return original(args)
        patcher = mock.patch.object(self.world, "git", side_effect=response)
        patcher.start(); self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)

    def test_all_equal_bases_have_one_complete_range_and_all_three_roles(self):
        base, sha = self.ordinary()

        self.world.files[sha, "docs/added.md"] = b"after"
        self.world.files[base, "docs/changed.md"] = b"before"
        self.world.files[sha, "docs/changed.md"] = b"after"
        result = self.forward(sha)
        audit = result.audit
        self.assertEqual(audit.candidate_sha, sha)
        self.assertEqual(audit.drills.raw, (ROOT / resolver._DRILLS).read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(audit.changes, (resolver.ChangedRange(
            ("database-origin", "latest-record", "selected-web"), base, sha,
            (resolver.ChangedPath("A", "docs/added.md"), resolver.ChangedPath("M", "docs/changed.md"),
             resolver.ChangedPath("D", "docs/removed.md"))),))
        with self.assertRaises(FrozenInstanceError): audit.drills.raw = b"other"
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): audit.changes[0].rows[0] = None

            self.boot["sha"]: ("selected-web",)})

class ForwardPendingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    setUp = ResolverTests.setUp
    add = ResolverTests.add
    profile = ForwardResolverTests.profile
    candidate = ForwardResolverTests.candidate
    forward = ForwardResolverTests.forward
    refused = ForwardResolverTests.refused
    ordinary = ForwardAuditTests.ordinary
    WORKFLOW = ForwardResolverTests.WORKFLOW
    MAIN = ForwardResolverTests.MAIN
    RECIPE = ForwardResolverTests.RECIPE

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        ResolverTests.setUpClass.__func__(cls)
        args = test_pending_plan.fixture()
        plan = pending_source.plan
        target_name = plan.PREFIX + "catalog-v1.json"
        target = json.loads(args["files"][target_name])
        target["objects"] = [*json.loads(cls.source_bytes[policy.GOLDEN])["objects"],
            *(row for row in target["objects"] if row["identity"] not in ("organizations", "organizations.id"))]
        globals_ = [*json.loads(cls.source_bytes[policy.GLOBALS]),
            *(row for row in json.loads(args["files"][plan.GLOBALS]) if row["name"] != "organizations")]
        cls.active = dict(active_catalog=cls.source_bytes[policy.GOLDEN],
                          active_globals=cls.source_bytes[policy.GLOBALS], active_history=cls.source_bytes[policy.HISTORY])
        files = {target_name: plan.canonical(target), plan.GLOBALS: plan.canonical(globals_)}
        document = json.loads(args["files"][plan.PLAN])
        document.update({key + "_file_sha256": plan.digest(raw) for key, raw in cls.active.items()})
        document["globals_file_sha256"] = plan.digest(files[plan.GLOBALS])
        document["entries"][0].update(catalog_file_sha256=plan.digest(files[target_name]),
                                     globals_sha256=plan.digest(files[plan.GLOBALS]))
        files[plan.PLAN] = plan.canonical(document)
        cls.pending_files = files

    def install(self, sha, files=None):
        files = self.pending_files if files is None else files
        self.world.files.update({(sha, path): raw for path, raw in files.items()})

    def replay(self, result):
        return pending_source.replay(result.pending, candidate_sha=result.candidate.sha,
            previous_sha=result.resolved.latest.record_sha, **self.active)

    def material_transport(self, change):
        # Alter only controlled outputs after the existing source audit starts;
        # prior classifier reads remain real fixed-source parser inputs.
        original = self.world.git
        active = False
        def response(args):
            nonlocal active
            if args[:2] == ["ls-tree", "-z"] and args[-1] == resolver._DRILLS:
                active = True
            result = original(args)
            return change(args, result) if active else result
        self.world.git = response

        self.assertEqual(len(projection.plan.entries[0].objects), 4452)
        self.assertEqual((result.pending.candidate_sha, result.pending.previous_sha), (sha, base))
        self.assertEqual(result.pending.candidate_files,
            tuple(pending_source.PendingBlob(path, raw) for path, raw in sorted(self.pending_files.items())))
        self.assertEqual(result.pending.previous_files, ())
        self.assertEqual((result.classification.kind, result.classification.dormant, result.classification.reasons),
                         ("expand", True, ()))
        self.assertEqual(result.classification.requirements, ("compat-required", "generated-migration-closure-ci"))
        self.assertEqual(result.candidate.catalog, self.v0.catalog)
        self.assertEqual(result.resolved.latest.live.origin_source.sha, base)
        self.assertEqual(result.resolved.latest.live.catalog, self.v0.catalog)
        with self.assertRaises(FrozenInstanceError): result.pending.previous_sha = sha
        with self.assertRaises(FrozenInstanceError): result.pending.candidate_files[0].raw = b"other"

            value = next(row for row in self.fake.tags if row["ref"] == "refs/tags/" + name)
        elif path.startswith(rt.API + "/releases/tags/"):
            name = path.removeprefix(rt.API + "/releases/tags/")
            value = next(row for row in self.fake.releases if row["tag_name"] == name)

            identity = int(path.rsplit("/", 1)[1])

import unittest

class AssetTlsRetryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    setUp = fixtures.ReleaseTransportTests.setUp
    client = fixtures.ReleaseTransportTests.client
